categories.description: The 100% category of Breath of the Wild traverses the entire map, and shows of the most glitches of any category. New glitch discoveries to this day keeps the speedruns fresh and times lower, the 100% category may even see a time as low as 14:XX this year, a full 24 hours of improvement since the end of 2017. The open world and freedom of choice gives rise to interesting routing, where there is few prerequisites for anything.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

categories.description: We get to see the full game! It is a longer category since there aren't any major skips, there are tons of movement optimisations like Circle Boosting, and some pretty cool skips like Binocucom Cancelling to get you quickly through five episodes of fun missions and beautiful aesthetics.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The fourth game in the Sly Cooper series, usually overshadowed by the original  PS2 trilogy. In terms of the speedrun though, its movement is the smoothest of the four. Despite its length, this game is surprisingly in-depth and jam-packed with a lot of strats and optimisations, as Sly and the gang rescue and work with the Cooper ancestors to beat the time-travellers trying to erase his history.
games.name: Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time

categories.description: Despite being a PSP game, this game is surprisingly in-depth in the run. With a major skip right off the bat and a lot of boundary breaking throughout the run, Any% shows off everything about what makes this game very fun. (in-detail timestamps/info of cool things are in the video description).
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The Jak and Daxter series is a classic beloved by many... though the same can't be said about this game. Released on the PSP in 2009, this game has a reputation for being the punching bag of the series. This run hopes to show off that this game isn't all that bad, and is quite a fun and unique run much like the previous entries in the series. This game has some broken missions, very hard bosses and a lot of dogfighting against Sky Pirates to restore the Eco balance of the world.
games.name: Jak and Daxter: The Lost Frontier

categories.description: We will be using 2 mods to make the run more watchable and exciting! The first mod is the Cutscene Remover which removes all cutscenes . 2nd mod is RNG Fix which makes the run completely random and exciting for viewers! We will also be doing a new found skip found last year that saves over 20 min!
categories.name: Cutscene Remover with RNG Fix

games.description: Final Fantasy X is the 10th main installment in the extremely popular Final Fantasy Franchise. This run will be using the Cutscene Remover which allows this run to be extremely watchable, and it’s also gonna include insane strategies to complete the game!
games.name: Final Fantasy X HD Remaster

categories.description: This run is Metal Gear Solid 3 on the highest difficulty! We have limited supplies, lower health and on top of all that we get a game over if we are ever discovered! This run will be insane to watch live and everyone will be on the edge of their seat watching this run!
categories.name: European Extreme

games.description: Metal Gear Solid 3 is the 3rd game in the popular Metal Gear Solid franchise. The run will feature a lot of stealth and extremely precise tricks, because the game ends whenever an enemy sees you! This run is extremely exciting and has a lot of intense moments.
games.name: Metal Gear Solid 3 HD Edition

categories.description: This category is the same as European Extreme but we will be collecting all 23 Optional camouflages and Facepaints! This run will be using a lot of alternative strats to ensure that we can collect them all!
categories.name: European Extreme All Camouflages and Facepaints

games.description: This run is Metal Gear Solid 3 on the highest difficulty! We have limited supplies, lower health and on top of all that we get a game over if we are ever discovered! This run will be insane to watch live and everyone will be on the edge of their seat watching this run!
games.name: Metal Gear Solid 3 HD Edition

categories.description: You ever want to see two dudes mash the space bar and mouse buttons to skip dialogue while also completing every side "mission" in the game? A race between two meme enjoying friends to see who is truly the best chore completer.
categories.name: All Side Chores

games.description: You play as Coop “Go Away, Weirdo” McCarthy and all you want to do is make the world a better place. The trouble is: Nobody likes you, school sucks, you can't find a prom date, everybody bullies you (including your teachers), and your attempts to help only make things worse. Will you escape high school alive? Who will love you? Do you even deserve love? Why is this game called Freakpocalypse? Find the answers to these questions and more  by interacting with ALL the things.
games.name: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse

categories.description: Complete the game as fast as possible with a variety of skips and OOB tricks.
categories.name: Any%

It is the fourth game in the Buffy the Vampire Slayer franchise, and the only multiplatform game. You take control of a variety of characters through 12 different levels as you fight the forces of evil to save the world from another apocalypse.
games.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds

categories.description: Running around South Park while it is doused in snow, and playing a new game with better rules so the New Kid doesn't become too OP (jokes on you, New Kid is always OP). But what if there are three new kids? Well, you get to beat up the main cast and manage RNG to your favor.
categories.name: All Chapters

games.description: Join Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny, in three-dimensional glory, to celebrate the most magical day in any young child’s life - a snow day! A massive blizzard has thrown the town into chaos and, more importantly, canceled school. Play with up to three friends and battle through the snow-piled town of South Park. Engage in frenetic, action-packed combat against warring factions in an all-new story where you make the rules. Rogue-like, card based abilities and random encounters!
games.name: South Park: Snow Day!

categories.description: Co-op Run with TaintedTali. Play through all four episodes of the story with all skills/upgrades unlocked.
categories.name: Any% Co-op NG+

games.description: Take control of Claire Redfield and Barry Burton in two different sides of the same story. In Claire's plot, follow her and Barry's daughter, Moira as they try to get off of a remote island swarming with infected. Barry's story takes place 6 months after the events that take place during Claire's time there as he searches for his daughter with the help of a young girl named Natalia.
games.name: Resident Evil: Revelations 2

categories.description:
The category for reaching the end of the game. Features some silly cutscenes, intense dialogue and sequence breaks.

There is only one "jump" that can lose some time, but run wise consistently beating the game in 20 minutes shouldn't be an issue.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Dragon Audit is a 3d adventure point and click game where you follow Ayraw, a half-dragon and George, a tax accountant on a silly journey of a tax audit.

The run is a lot of optimization regarding what order to do things in regards to menuing, dialogue, and general routing. In the second half due to an interesting physics system we can also sequence break the game, allowing us to reach stuff out of order and speed things up.  The run shows some of the games goofiness in certain cutscenes
games.name: Dragon Audit

categories.description: Low% insane is beating the game on insane difficulty (1 health) without picking up anything that isn't strictly necessary to beat the game. In contrast to other categories of this game you have to master the bosses movesets because you can't use strong items to kill them, making them quite tense.
categories.name: Low% insane

games.description:
Momodora is a 2D action platformer with some metroidvania and Dark Souls inspiration. It is a short and sweet game with simple but satisfying movement that looks quite smooth and some bossfights that add excitement to the run.

The chosen category hasn't been shown at ESA before and shows some boss strategies and also some skips that haven't been featured at ESA.

categories.description: We get to see the full game! It is a longer category since there aren't any major skips, there are tons of movement optimisations like Circle Boosting, and some pretty cool skips like Binocucom Cancelling to get you quickly through five episodes of fun missions and beautiful aesthetics.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The fourth game in the Sly Cooper series, usually overshadowed by the original  PS2 trilogy. In terms of the speedrun though, its movement is the smoothest of the four. Despite its length, this game is surprisingly in-depth and jam-packed with a lot of strats and optimisations, as Sly and the gang rescue and work with the Cooper ancestors to beat the time-travellers trying to erase his history.
games.name: Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time

categories.description: Despite being a PSP game, this game is surprisingly in-depth in the run. With a major skip right off the bat and a lot of boundary breaking throughout the run, Any% shows off everything about what makes this game very fun. (in-detail timestamps/info of cool things are in the video description).
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The Jak and Daxter series is a classic beloved by many... though the same can't be said about this game. Released on the PSP in 2009, this game has a reputation for being the punching bag of the series. This run hopes to show off that this game isn't all that bad, and is quite a fun and unique run much like the previous entries in the series. This game has some broken missions, very hard bosses and a lot of dogfighting against Sky Pirates to restore the Eco balance of the world.
games.name: Jak and Daxter: The Lost Frontier

categories.description: We will be using 2 mods to make the run more watchable and exciting! The first mod is the Cutscene Remover which removes all cutscenes . 2nd mod is RNG Fix which makes the run completely random and exciting for viewers! We will also be doing a new found skip found last year that saves over 20 min!
categories.name: Cutscene Remover with RNG Fix

games.description: Final Fantasy X is the 10th main installment in the extremely popular Final Fantasy Franchise. This run will be using the Cutscene Remover which allows this run to be extremely watchable, and it’s also gonna include insane strategies to complete the game!
games.name: Final Fantasy X HD Remaster

categories.description: This run is Metal Gear Solid 3 on the highest difficulty! We have limited supplies, lower health and on top of all that we get a game over if we are ever discovered! This run will be insane to watch live and everyone will be on the edge of their seat watching this run!
categories.name: European Extreme

games.description: Metal Gear Solid 3 is the 3rd game in the popular Metal Gear Solid franchise. The run will feature a lot of stealth and extremely precise tricks, because the game ends whenever an enemy sees you! This run is extremely exciting and has a lot of intense moments.
games.name: Metal Gear Solid 3 HD Edition

categories.description: This category is the same as European Extreme but we will be collecting all 23 Optional camouflages and Facepaints! This run will be using a lot of alternative strats to ensure that we can collect them all!
categories.name: European Extreme All Camouflages and Facepaints

games.description: This run is Metal Gear Solid 3 on the highest difficulty! We have limited supplies, lower health and on top of all that we get a game over if we are ever discovered! This run will be insane to watch live and everyone will be on the edge of their seat watching this run!
games.name: Metal Gear Solid 3 HD Edition

categories.description: You ever want to see two dudes mash the space bar and mouse buttons to skip dialogue while also completing every side "mission" in the game? A race between two meme enjoying friends to see who is truly the best chore completer.
categories.name: All Side Chores

games.description: You play as Coop “Go Away, Weirdo” McCarthy and all you want to do is make the world a better place. The trouble is: Nobody likes you, school sucks, you can't find a prom date, everybody bullies you (including your teachers), and your attempts to help only make things worse. Will you escape high school alive? Who will love you? Do you even deserve love? Why is this game called Freakpocalypse? Find the answers to these questions and more  by interacting with ALL the things.
games.name: Cyanide & Happiness: Freakpocalypse

categories.description: Complete the game as fast as possible with a variety of skips and OOB tricks.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds is an action beat 'em up video game developed by Eurocom Entertainment Software and published by Vivendi Universal Games. It is the fourth game in the Buffy the Vampire Slayer franchise, and the only multiplatform game. You take control of a variety of characters through 12 different levels as you fight the forces of evil to save the world from another apocalypse.
games.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Chaos Bleeds

categories.description: Running around South Park while it is doused in snow, and playing a new game with better rules so the New Kid doesn't become too OP (jokes on you, New Kid is always OP). But what if there are three new kids? Well, you get to beat up the main cast and manage RNG to your favor.
categories.name: All Chapters

games.description: Join Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny, in three-dimensional glory, to celebrate the most magical day in any young child’s life - a snow day! A massive blizzard has thrown the town into chaos and, more importantly, canceled school. Play with up to three friends and battle through the snow-piled town of South Park. Engage in frenetic, action-packed combat against warring factions in an all-new story where you make the rules. Rogue-like, card based abilities and random encounters!
games.name: South Park: Snow Day!

categories.description: Co-op Run with TaintedTali. Play through all four episodes of the story with all skills/upgrades unlocked.
categories.name: Any% Co-op NG+

games.description: Take control of Claire Redfield and Barry Burton in two different sides of the same story. In Claire's plot, follow her and Barry's daughter, Moira as they try to get off of a remote island swarming with infected. Barry's story takes place 6 months after the events that take place during Claire's time there as he searches for his daughter with the help of a young girl named Natalia.
games.name: Resident Evil: Revelations 2

categories.description:
The category for reaching the end of the game. Features some silly cutscenes, intense dialogue and sequence breaks.

There is only one "jump" that can lose some time, but run wise consistently beating the game in 20 minutes shouldn't be an issue.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Dragon Audit is a 3d adventure point and click game where you follow Ayraw, a half-dragon and George, a tax accountant on a silly journey of a tax audit.

The run is a lot of optimization regarding what order to do things in regards to menuing, dialogue, and general routing. In the second half due to an interesting physics system we can also sequence break the game, allowing us to reach stuff out of order and speed things up.  The run shows some of the games goofiness in certain cutscenes
games.name: Dragon Audit

categories.description: Low% insane is beating the game on insane difficulty (1 health) without picking up anything that isn't strictly necessary to beat the game. In contrast to other categories of this game you have to master the bosses movesets because you can't use strong items to kill them, making them quite tense.
categories.name: Low% insane

games.description:
Momodora is a 2D action platformer with some metroidvania and Dark Souls inspiration. It is a short and sweet game with simple but satisfying movement that looks quite smooth and some bossfights that add excitement to the run.

The chosen category hasn't been shown at ESA before and shows some boss strategies and also some skips that haven't been featured at ESA.
games.name: Momodora: Reverie Under the Moonlight

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible!
categories.name: Any% Co-op

games.description:
Just like Maniac Mansion, this is a ported game from earlier consoles. It's a fantastic hidden gem that sadly didn't get that much attention in Europe because of it's late release.
The run is alot of fun because you never know what can occur! There are 31 stages and 4 bosses.
games.name: Rod Land

categories.description: Standard Any% category. Simply finish the run without any restrictions.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: One of the 3 games made after the show of the same name. The game features a lot of broken tech such as double jumping, hovering over the entire map and to the end of the level and even moonwalking. There are also combat portions with unique strats and point routing. People who watched the show will enjoy the speedrun and also people who just like broken runs will enjoy this. WII is the optimal console for this game due to loads and the fact that some glitches are patched on other versions.
games.name: Code Lyoko: Quest for Infinity

categories.description: The category starts from a fresh file. The goal is to get first ending of the game.
categories.name: Any% A Ending

games.description: First Nier game in the series. The run focuses on multiple things such as good movement, fights, managing resources and RNG. Due to game's strict progression, the run is very linear while also being quite chill and having a few skips. Movement can be quite pleasant to preform, fights feature all sorts of different strats as we progress through the game's story, managing resources such as items that increase our damage and RNG which decides our shopping trips all combine for a fun speedrun.
games.name: Nier

categories.description: All Abilities means we have to collect every single ability before finishing the run. Clipping out of bounds is not allowed in this category.
categories.name: All Abilities (No OOB) Full Gold Patch

games.description: Game made for a game jam which ended up getting a lot of positive feedback and ended up releasing on steam. Game features variety of tech which allows us to zoom through the game very quickly while also looking really swag. Most basic examples are glide hops which give as a lot of speed and slide hops which give us height. Using the tech of this game while traversing through this game's levels can really hype up the crowd and the people watching the stream.
games.name: Pseudoregalia

categories.description: In NG+ category we have all optimal weapons upgraded to level 10 which helps us shred through pretty much any fight/boss in the game. We also have all 28 gold bolts which gives us the option to make the game 25% along with some other useful stuff.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: Remake of the first Ratchet & Clank game. The speedrun of this game mostly focuses on doing a lot of OOB skips to beat the levels quickly, while also utilizing glitches like screen of death, a wrong warp which in some cases would put as at the end of the level.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank (PS4)

categories.description: Any% No Major Glitches, usage of glitches such as zipping, menu glitches, rewind glitches, etc is banned and because of that, the category relies on mostly doing optimal movement.
categories.name: Any% No Major Glitches

games.description: 3rd Prince of Persia game of the sands trilogy. Game leaves off exactly where Warrior Within (the 2nd game) ended. Prince of Persia games are known for their smooth movement and platforming. There is some mandatory combat here and there during the run but the game is mostly focuses on movement.
games.name: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones

categories.description: Beat the game... although - because of the skill issues and because QS/QL for like 4 min is boring, I guess it's going to be all inbounds.
categories.name: any%

games.description: SiN Episodes: Emergence is the first (and only) episode in what was suppose to be an episodic sequel to 1998's SiN. The game is running on Source engine and having some characteristic of an old-Source engine run. Has some nice movement, prop flying and a possible Dopefish easter egg encounter.
games.name: SiN Episodes: Emergence

categories.description: Just beat the game - if this gets accepted, I will attempt to implement at least 1 alternative ending into the route for possible donation incentive/goal (if not all of them).
categories.name: any%

games.description: An infamous sequel to 2000's Deus Ex. Lots of loads, decent potential for the game crashing,  loads of junk and shooting people you should not be shooting.
games.name: Deus Ex: Invisible War

categories.description: I want to show some easy but awesome strats that turn Hitman into a great party trick for very nerdy parties, and demonstrate how to approach it from a routing perspective. Exact details pending, but if I can't do something fun with Blood Money for half an hour I need to rethink the last 15 years.
categories.name: Showcase

games.description: It's that game where you push people over and they die and it's funny. I'm a washed-up has-been but I've ran Blood Money at a ton of marathons and every time I've tried to make the run new and different in some way, while also doing my best to make sure it's fun and easy to follow for people who don't know the game. It's ridiculously open ended in a way that makes it both a good watch and great game to route and run, making it one of the best speedgames out there.
games.name: Hitman: Blood Money

categories.description: Final piece of the RDR2 Puzzle. The Epilogue follows John Marston as he tries to escape his past, but when the chance for revenge presents itself, he jumps at the chance.
categories.name: Epilogue

games.description: GTA Style 3rd person action game, taking place in the Wild West of 1899.
games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2

categories.description:
Easy is pretty much the any% of Halo speedruns. Dying to enemies is generally not an issue so all the focus goes on movement, skips and efficient combat. 
The relay race will involve 18 players: 2 teams of 9, one player for each level with most runners having plenty of prior experience in the game.
categories.name: Easy

games.description: Classic FPS game with mix of movement and combat. Lots of easy to grasp physics based tricks and skips.
games.name: Halo 3

categories.description: Legendary is the highest difficulty and makes every combat section incredibly difficult. It heavily changes the run and can make for great races as the lead can swing at any moment, as deaths are common and large time sinks.
categories.name: Legendary

games.description: FPS game with a good mix of movement and combat heavy sections.
games.name: Halo: Reach

categories.description: Average-Mode any% is the bread-and-butter category of Boshy , with almost 100 runners on the leaderboards and years of grinding and optimization to push the record to below 30 minutes. It's the most fast paced category and the most save one to run at a marathon.
categories.name: Average-Mode any% (Dark Boshy, No Wrong Warp)

games.description:
Boshy is probably the most famous Fangame of I wanna be the Guy. It includes a lot of fast paced platforming, as well as very diffcult bosses. The worlds and bosses are based on classic retro games like Megaman, Sonic, Kirby and Castlevania.

It has been shown in plenty of marathons before and usually had very good reception, as most viewers do not dare to even touch this game casually.
games.name: I wanna be the Boshy

categories.description: This category collects every chest in the game (unlocking various Music CDs, characters and other fancy stuff). That means you see almost everything the game has to offer. However, it is a lot slower paced because you spend a lot of time in the chest opening cutscene.

It has been shown in plenty of marathons before and usually had very good reception, as most viewers do not dare to even touch this game casually.
games.name: I wanna be the Boshy

categories.description: Rage-Mode is the highest difficulty setting of Boshy. It removes most saves from the game, only leaving you with 1 save at the start and the end of each world (with some exceptions). Also, bosses have double HP. This is very marathon unsave, but some new tech has been found since I ran this at ESA.
categories.name: Rage-Mode any% (Dark Boshy, No Wrong Warp)

It has been shown in plenty of marathons before and usually had very good reception, as most viewers do not dare to even touch this game casually.
games.name: I wanna be the Boshy

categories.description:
Similar to past Relay runs at ESA, I'd like to suggest doing one for Boshy. The game has 11 Worlds and 11 Bosses, so I'd try to find 11 (or 22) brave souls that would like to learn a world and/or a boss each.
I am aware this can go horribly wrong, but I'll try my best to make sure people practice.
categories.name: The Boshy Relay

Boshy is probably the most famous Fangame of I wanna be the Guy. It includes a lot of fast paced platforming, as well as very diffcult bosses. The worlds and bosses are based on classic retro games like Megaman, Sonic, Kirby and Castlevania.

It has been shown in plenty of marathons before and usually had very good reception, as most viewers do not dare to even touch this game casually.
games.name: I wanna be the Boshy

categories.description: Complete all missions/ the whole game as fast as possible on Legendary(hardest)   difficulty.
categories.name: Legendary

games.description: Halo is a well-known FPS game celebrated for its thrilling space action and iconic characters, including Spartan 117, also known as Master Chief. The Halo 5 speedrun include  numerous out-of-bounds  sections alongside combat-intensive areas (amplified by playing on Legendary  difficulty).  Viewers can anticipate witnessing a variety of unique and surprising strategies as the we exploit  glitches and utilize new mechanics introduced in Halo 5 to complete the game as fast as possible!
games.name: Halo 5

categories.description: The Pelican Route focuses heavily on movement tech and the use of the Pelican vehicle. The grapple hook gets upgraded as soon as possible because it lets us go out of bounds and skip a majority of the levels. We also have acces to a Tank Gun! ... Yes, you read that right. TANK gun!
categories.name: Any% Pelican Route

games.description: Halo Infinite is the latest installment in the main-series Halo games and the first attempt at an open world scenario. The Any% route has a few variations, of which the Pelican Route has the most available glitches, tricks, and major sequence breaks. There is less focus on combat and instead relies mostly on movement tech and efficient use of armor abilities. It's a great showcase of what Halo Infinite is capable of. It's a fun run!
games.name: Halo Infinite

categories.description: Community-made mod to make the run more enjoyable to play and watch as a result! Skips all the big autoscrollers and waiting sections and gives us the energy sword on every level to maximise speed and tricks. This has never been ran at a marathon before, would be great to show it off.
categories.name: Speed Mod

games.description: Halo 2 is an FPS which has been a popular speedrun for many years. It came to PC in 2020 and has a strong community. It is arguably the most popular Halo game to speedrun as a player and viewer and has a great history at many past marathons. 'Sword tricks' are unique to Halo 2 and give it incredibly enjoyable movement tech.
games.name: Halo 2

categories.description: NG+ plays through every mission using the mission replay feature, as well as having all skills unlocked.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: Mirror's Edge Catalyst is a reboot of the Cult Classic Mirror's Edge, however it provides a completely different experience. Catalyst is open world where faith is fighting against Kruger sec and the distribution of Reflection.  We replay each mission with the upgrades unlocked which means we can use Faith's movement to the fullest, we also abuse the open world nature of the game allowing us to do unique skips only seen in ng+ that have yet to be seen at a marathon.
games.name: Mirror's Edge Catalyst

categories.description: Beat Every boss by any means.
categories.name: All Bosses

games.description: Obama may be a short game but it doesn't hold back in terms of content. The game is a movement based third person adventure game with combat that can only be described as easier Dark Souls with bullet hell mechanics thrown in. In this short amount of time we'll be taking on 4 unique bosses and moving throughout the world using a grapple hook paired with a triple jump to maintain speed. This game has combat, movement and plenty out of bounds all crammed into a quick run with little downtime.
games.name: Obama

categories.description: AMC (Coop) is all about teamwork, each person will have different strats in the test champers to complete while also being reliant on eachother. We will be playing though all the Main Courses in the Coop campaign! (this time it will be a higher skill showcase with Seskal rather than a meme showcase)
categories.name: AMC (Coop)

games.description: Puzzlegames are different in speedruns since you already know the solution to all the puzzles, the interesting parts of the game shows in its movement and solution. Everything is based on shooting portals midair while bunnyhopping and flying though levels! Using all the tools the engine gives you to speed though test champers while listening to the lovely sound of glados
games.name: Portal 2

categories.description: This category takes you through the 13 events that take place between Episode III through Episode V (minus the space missions). Travel through the betrayal of the Jedi in this thriller 13-part series
categories.name: Any% with bonuses

games.description: Star Wars Battlefront II is a beautiful game that has 20 different battlefronts, and includes categories like the Campaign, Galactic Conquest, and Instant Action. The Campaign takes you from events in Episode III to Episode V, and you can travel the galaxy in Galactic Conquest and Instant Action.
games.name: Star Wars Battlefront II (Classic 2005)

categories.description: The any% run is absolutely crazy! It abuses level geometry bugs (1:06 and 5:52 video time). Abusing a bug we can basically fly and there are many ways to get out of bounds with this category (1:39, 4:32). We also use some funny AI abuses (15:00, 18:04) and we even kill a boss with a cutscene (7:53).
categories.name: any% easy

games.description:
Oni is a 3rd person brawler and shooter. It is my No1 favorite game of all time, because it has a very fluid combination of armed and unarmed combat combined with a wide spectrum of guns and moves. To this day still the best that I know (excluding pure fighting games maybe).
The game had a fair amount of popularity back in 2001, when it released. I’m sure people will remember it. It also has a very passionate discord community with around 1200 members all around the world!
games.name: Oni

categories.description: You defeat the Shadow Lord (Rank 5) with no event bonuses. These bonuses change monthly, and it is possible July will have one that affects the run (extra exp, etc), causing the run to become Event (makes the run shorter). But it will be impossible to know until July. Very safe estimate due to RNG.
categories.name: Shadow Lord (Solo, Non-Event)

games.description: Final Fantasy XI is an MMO and the run ignores all other players and player interaction to run through and defeat the Shadow Lord (Rank 5 mission) as fast as possible. You use Trusts, Sparks, and other newer game mechanics added as the game went on to trivialize twenty year old content that players struggled with back then. You farm quest items, level up as fast as possible, and then do a bunch of missions and defeat the Shadow Lord.
games.name: Final Fantasy XI

categories.description: Legendary is the hardest difficulty setting in Halo 3: ODST. This rarely seen full-game category shows off all that ODST has to offer including challenging combat, cone launches, tire launches, debris launches (there are some cool launches...) and just the right amount of 'out of bounds' tricks.
categories.name: Legendary

games.description: Halo 3: ODST tells the story of Alpha-9, an Orbital Drop Shock Trooper squad deployed during the invasion of Earth. The Rookie, who is stranded on the streets of New Mombasa at night, must navigate through the Covenant patrols to uncover the clues and find out what happen to his squad. Throughout the game the player experiences missions as all the members of the squad. The gameplay features the familiar sandbox of the Halo 3 engine with refinements and additions.
games.name: Halo 3: ODST

categories.description: This category is beating all 5 games as fast as possible, meaning beating the Any% category for all 5 of the games in a row. Run showcased at SGDQ 2023.
categories.name: Main Series

games.description: The Elder Scrolls Anthology is the set of all 5 of the main series Elder Scrolls games ran in a row. This includes The Elder Scrolls: Arena, The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall, The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind, The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Each game has their own unique mechanics in every aspect, with each game having vastly different movement from buffer jumps, Keening flying, and horse tilting, along with all their own quirks that make each game spectacular.
games.name: The Elder Scrolls Anthology

categories.description: Complete all missions of Halo CE on the Legendary (highest) difficulty,
categories.name: Legendary

games.description: The first game of the Halo franchise, an FPS game with many tricks and glitches, along with fast paced combat sequences, teleports using geometry and unique game physics, massive grenade jumps and launches, and even more. I showcased this run at ESA Corona Relief and AGDQ 2022 Online. xTunguzka will be helping with commentary (Ran at ESA Summer 2022)
games.name: Halo CE

categories.description: Complete all the main acts of the game on any difficulty level.
categories.name: Any% All Acts

games.description: Baldur's Gate 3 is the GOTY of 2023, an RPG that features some of the most unique glitches in a speedrun. From doing some glitches that are totally out of character, including kidnapping NPCs, killing your own party members and using their corpse to teleport, and accessing dev rooms with standard gameplay mechanics, this run is wildly different than a casual playthrough.
games.name: Baldur's Gate 3

categories.description: No Major Glitches are used in the run.  Honour Mode refers to the highest difficulty level that the game offers, locked at a single save file. There are many backups and the run should be marathon safe. Run on the latest patch of the game (Patch 6), which is a few minutes slower than other runs.
categories.name: No Major Glitches - Honour Mode

games.description: Baldur's Gate 3 is the GOTY of 2023, an RPG that takes hundreds of hours to complete normally, but without glitches, you are able to beat the full run at the final act of the game in under an hour. This is done by abusing some unique mechanics of the game that is all intended gameplay to create a fantastic run, including doing actions that many people have not encountered casually, to creating character builds that are not standard to typical gameplay. This run is truly "explosive".
games.name: Baldur's Gate 3

categories.description: New Game Minus is a game made mode in which characters can't receive experience, meaning our characters will remain on their low starting levels for the entire run. We will need to use a clever range of strategies to overcome being so low level, while losing little time compared to regular new game.
categories.name: Any% - New Game Minus

games.description: Final Fantasy XII: The Zodiac Age is the remastered version of the 12th installment of the Final Fantasy series. This version includes a job system, allowing us to choose combinations of 2 jobs for each of the characters and learn abilities associated with those jobs. The gambit system allows us to program our characters, which we can use in combination with a x4 speedup function to make quick work of battles. The game's auto-save feature help make the run very marathon safe.
games.name: Final Fantasy XII: The Zodiac Age

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible as the standard character, Freudia.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A classic Mega Man series clone released in 2012 with a questionable anime artstyle. A fast paced speedrun featuring lots of movement tricks like jet slides and a recently discovered refight skip in the 2nd last stage of the game. Wow! Better not miss out on this one!
games.name: Rosenkreuzstilette Freudenstachel

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible as Mega Man on normal difficulty
categories.name: Any%

games.description: One of the NES style Mega Man games, released in 2010. Great soundtrack. Features quick weapon swaps, which enables a good variety of weapons used throughout the run.
games.name: Mega Man 10

categories.description: NG+ in this game as with most games carries over your abilities and other things from a completed file. in this case we start with EX skills and more importantly the Junk armor which doubles our damage output at the cost of doubling our damage taken.
categories.name: any% NG+

games.description: 4th game of the MMZ series, requires a lot of adaptability and precise movement.
games.name: Mega Man Zero 4

categories.description: basic any% run. goes through all the stages with minimal big glitches. colors are nice and pretty.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Romhack of MMV for GB. Adds color and removes lag.
games.name: Mega Man World 5 DX

categories.description: We make use of some glitches to trigger the end flag for 2 scenarios early skipping about half the game.
categories.name: any%

games.description: A JP only scenario based JRPG for the SNES. Very noteworthy for having an extremely unique magic system where you just type in your own spells whenever and add them to your arsenal. Theres 3 main scenarios and then a final scenario unlocked afterwards.
games.name: Rudra no Hihou / Treasure of the Rudras

categories.description: zipping and zipping and zipping. very hard, very adorable. usagi.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Rat based Mega Man clone. May require Doom Eternal to work on modern hardware.
games.name: Nezumi Man

categories.description: True Completion, as the name suggests, is the most completionist of all categories Super Metroid has, with all items, map tiles, bosses, and a few other things collected in the run. Though the category is more esoteric than some, there is no doubt of the high optimization that has gone into the run.
categories.name: True Completion

games.description: Super Metroid is a classic marathon game that has been featured to rave reviews at many popular marathons in the past. Featuring tight movement, stylistic and impressive tricks, as well as the classic save-or-kill animals bidwar at the end, Super Metroid is an electric game that is sure to be a fine showcase at any event.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: 98% Suitless, also called Max% Suitless, is essentially a 100% run of Super Metroid with one small twist: no suits! Unfortunately, the suits are the most powerful items in the game, so many shenanigans must be pulled off to properly collect all the other items while fully skipping the suits.
categories.name: 98% Suitless

games.description: Super Metroid is a classic marathon game that has been featured to rave reviews at many popular marathons in the past. Featuring tight movement, stylistic and impressive tricks, as well as the classic save-or-kill animals bidwar at the end, Super Metroid is an electric game that is sure to be a fine showcase at any event.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: Eriror and mm2nescartridge will complete the randomizer co-op style, with Eriror playing A Link to the Past and mm2nescartridge playing Super Metroid, trading off at game transitions. Submission video is of a previous marathon run of a similar format to what is submitted.
categories.name: Co-op Randomizer

games.description: The Super Metroid and A Link to the Past Combo Randomizer (commonly abbreviated SMZ3) takes two classic SNES titles, connects them via four in-game portals, and randomizes the items across both games! The runners are challenged to find all the items required to beat both games as fast as possible, collecting seven crystals and defeating Ganon for A Link to the Past, as well as four tokens to defeat Mother Brain for Super Metroid.
games.name: Super Metroid and A Link to the Past Combo Randomizer

categories.description: The goal is to get 70 Stars and enough abilities to beat the game.
categories.name: Ability Randomizer

games.description:
A new way of playing SM64 has just come out! With the help of the Archipelago Randomizer you can now randomize Mario's abilities.
You start with just "jump" and "punch" and have to route your way through the game by unlocking more abilities like "Long Jump", "Ground Pound" and "Ledge Grab" to name a few. With more abilities more Stars will be obtainable which will lead to more unlocks.
games.name: Super Mario 64 Archipelago

categories.description:
The goal of this run is to navigate through a 3 game randomized seed and beat Champion in Pokemon, the final Bowser in SM64 and the Ender Dragon in Minecraft. 
I will need to find 8 Badges and enough Key Items, 70 Stars and the Bowser Keys, and unlock enough recipes and items to reach the MC Dragon.
categories.name: Multiworld Randomizer

games.description:
This is a Multiworld randomizer using http://archipelago.gg that combines multiple games to form one big randomizer. It combines all items/checks from all games into 1 item pool. When you grab an item in 1 game it can be an item from another and is automatically sent to that inventory. 
(See this for good layout, all 3 games in 16:9 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgIqYP-XyKs | Every game should be visible at the same time but only the active game needs to be big)
games.name: Pokemon Emerald x Minecraft x Super Mario 64

categories.description: In this run you must navigate the flood tunnels of Captain Flameheart's lair, traverse all three passages and the final gauntlet filled to the brim with pits of lava, spikes and sawblade booby traps.
categories.name: Heart of Fire Gauntlet

games.description:
Sea of Thieves is an adventure-sandbox game which just surpassed 40 million players.

This run uses a section of the Story Mode (Tall Tales) transformed into a fun and challenging speedrun.

Sword lunges which convert weapon momentum into a long distance jump, platform skips, and firebomb trickshots are all used to traverse this game quickly.
games.name: Sea of Thieves

categories.description: NLBLLG stands for, No License Board Low Level Game. You'll basically play the game as weak as possible throughout the entire run. The characters will never reach 200HP (max) and the best weapon is a 19 attack gun. It's really hard and really long. Due to it's length, it's a joke submission.
categories.name: NLBLLG

games.description: The twelfth installment of the Final Fantasy franchise. Follow 6 party members on their journey to safe Dalmasca from being Destroyed by the Empire with their Crystals, the Nethecites.
games.name: Final Fantasy XII

categories.description: With a mix between melee and magick we make our way through the game. Using the different strategies and specific technics like traveller to deal a lot of damage in a short amount of time.  This might change, though, if one of the major reroute ideas turns out to be faster. Stay tuned!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The twelfth installment of the Final Fantasy franchise. Follow 6 party members on their journey to safe Dalmasca from being Destroyed by the Empire with their Crystals, the Nethecites. Now in HD with adjusted licenses, stats etc.
games.name: Final Fantasy XII: The Zodiac Age

categories.description: With low level characters (not lowest level), we'll make our way through the game by using damage multipliers and very low HP characters to deal massive damage to our foes! A single character as  a  Tank with roughly 2000HP stays between run alive or not. An Edge of the seat experience for everyone!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The twelfth installment of the Final Fantasy franchise. Follow 6 party members on their journey to safe Dalmasca from being Destroyed by the Empire with their Crystals, the Nethecites.
games.name: Final Fantasy XII

categories.description: 101% (Glitched) involves completing the Adventure Mode of CTR, including all collectables that are available. This run allows all the glitches that are in the game, leading to this category being the best showcase of both the tight racing and satisfying, crazy glitches that CTR offers.

games.description: CTR is a Racing game for the PS1 that has everything that a racing game should have, Technical driving, cornering and drifting that is simple to understand, difficult to master but easy to explain fundamentals, and insane skips that are easy on the eye. This game is a perfect example of a racing game that lends itself to speedrunning. (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Crash Team Racing

categories.description: Any% is the quintessential category for Croc 2. It sees you go from the start of the game, to beating the final boss, with all the glitches that the game has to offer allowed for the speedrun.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Croc 2 is a platformer for the PS1 that sees you traverse 4 worlds, battling pits, tricky jumps, and bosses. This game as a speedrun however allows for a lot of eye catching tricks and tech that are not often associated with a 3D platformer of its kind, allowing for a unique showcase that sets it apart from Croc 1, and other games in the genre.  (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Croc 2

categories.description: Any% (No Major Glitches) involves beating all 5 bosses and all 16 trophy the game has. This category still has all the insane skips that save a lot of time, but no shortcuts that skip tracks or levels in there entirety, meaning that beating every level uniquely is still a requirement.
categories.name: Any% (No Major Glitches)

games.description: CTR is a Racing game for the PS1 that has everything that a racing game should have, Technical driving, cornering and drifting that is simple to understand, difficult to master but easy to explain fundamentals, and insane skips that are easy on the eye. This game is a perfect example of a racing game that lends itself to speedrunning. (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Crash Team Racing

categories.description:
Any% (No Penguin Spacewalking) is the standard category for Crash Tag Team Racing, and requires you to go through the 5 worlds and beat the game with only banning 1 tech. (that is not marathon safe) 

every other glitch is allowed, enabling quite the showcase.
categories.name: Any% (No PSW)

games.description: CTTR is both a Platformer, and a Racing game that combines both genres to make a wildly fascinating speedrun. This game truly has it all, having both skips and technical movement, in both the genres that the game has you play. A speedrun that has not been seen in a marathon of this size ever before, and is sure to raise a few eyebrows.
games.name: Crash Tag Team Racing

categories.description: 96 Tracks (200cc, Items On) involves beating every single track in the game, on the fastest speed setting, with the items on, meaning there is a fair amount of RNG, but the speed of the run is still a great watch. The ideal category for a speedrun marathon.
categories.name: 96 Tracks (200cc, Items On)

games.description: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe is a Kart Racer for the Nintendo Switch and is widely regarded as the quintessential kart racer of the current console generation. It is the perfect game for a showcase such as this due to the combination of easy to understand gameplay as well as flashy skips.
games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

categories.description: (UPDATED SUBMISSION 22/04/24) 4 Button game mode (4-lanes, 2 side tracks) with songs in the 8-11* difficulty range as warm-up with 12*-13* being the main show and 14-15* songs being the closer.  A commentated run is linked in the submission video description.
categories.name: 4B Showcase

games.description: DJMAX Respect V is a vertical-scrolling rhythm game similar to that of  Stepmania or OSU! Mania.  The game is primarily played with a keyboard and features a unique mechanic known as the side track which essentially is two additional lanes that can grant additional points.  DJMAX features a wide variety of songs from a wide array of genres with different game modes and difficulties.  The showcase will show off the 4B Game mode with songs ranging from 8* to 14* with a focus on 12-13* difficulty.
games.name: DJMAX Respect V

categories.description: Estimate based on time with loads. Any% Co-op is the most optimal way to play Balan Wonderworld.  By playing in Co-op you get access to an additional jump and the ability to combine costume powerups.  This allows for some wild skips that are impossible in singleplayer.
categories.name: Any% Co-op (1 player)

games.description: Balan Wonderworld had its five minutes of infamy in 2021 after being branded as a slow-paced, restrictive 3D platformer.  However, the speedrunning community for the game managed to break it wide open by taking advantage of a handful of broken power-ups, intuitive routing, and questionable-level design.  Balan is now a surprisingly interesting speedrun despite the infamy as you will see players performing major skips, OOB glitches, and in some cases flying through a level like it's a sonic game.
games.name: Balan Wonderworld

categories.description: The goal of any% is to reach the credits from a fresh file as fast as possible.  This is done by getting 27 emblems of courage through any means necessary.  The category features the game's best skips and glitches.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Billy Hatcher and the Giant Egg (BH) is a hidden gem, egg-rolling 3D-Platformer published by Sonic Team in 2003.  BH is a technical, yet simple showcase of a unique movement system that centralizes around the concept of rolling around eggs.  The game features numerous exciting glitches, skips, and ways to take advantage of the game's wonky physics to create a wildly fun and surprising speedrun.  The game is supported by its charm and passionate speedrunning community.
games.name: Billy Hatcher and the Giant Egg

categories.description: The any% speedrun has lots of cool OoB skips, movement bugs, grenade boosts, and some very creative ways to end certain levels. Almost all levels have some kind of exploit, some levels being more broken than others. Some good examples of this are lvl 7 Bunker, lvl 13 Cooler and lvl 20 Volcano.
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: FC1 is a linear 1st person shooter from 2004, made by CryTek (the developers who made Crysis 1-3). You play as Jack Carver, and you have to fight through an army of mercenaries and monsters to get yourself, and your female companion Lara Cro- I mean, Valerie Constantine to safety. The levels are generally short, but very diverse in scenery and gameplay. You navigate them on foot, in cars and boats, and even an occational hangglider.
games.name: Far Cry 1

categories.description: You are not allowed to kill any character, except for the one, who is required for the story.
categories.name: Pacifist

games.description: The game is a story rich, platform, light puzzle game made in hand drawn Ghibli style. You play as Anne, an enforcer, who is out to find and capture the leader of the rebels, who is trying to stop you from returning back home, to the human world. Anne learn more of the world she lives in, as well as about herself. The choices you make in the game can impact characters life. Will you take it or let them go? The game can also be in 2560x1440 resolution
games.name: Forgotton Anne

categories.description: In All Dungeons RMG we eschew the traditional dungeon order and progression through the game, but incorporate clips and other glitches in order to speed up the game and show off cool sequence breaks, while still having a lot of actual gameplay. Co-comms are mm2nescartridge and humbugh.
categories.name: All Dungeons - Restricted Major Glitches

games.description: Zelda: ALTTP is the third installment of the classic series where Link traverses the world and countless dungeons to find items to unlock more locations in order to save the world.  The speedruns are mainly focused on execution and movement while reacting to all the enemy RNG and minimizing its timelosses, while incrementally getting more options and items to finish the game as fast as possible.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past

categories.description: FF12 Any% is one of the hardest Any% runs of the series. There have been many route improvements in the last 5 years or so that have made it a lot faster and more consistent to perform on marathons though. Money and resource managements are nearly as important as execution.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Final Fantasy XII is the first one in the main series to have cutscene skips. Unlike earlier games of the series, there are no random encounters, but enemies roam the battlefield. This makes skill much bigger factor than luck in the runs. The run is mostly played on Active Battle Mode which allows you to do battle menus and move at the same time making gameplay fast and interesting to watch. There are no major skips in the game but there are a couple of minor glitches that we take advantage of.
games.name: Final Fantasy XII

categories.description: This category can just be called Any% as QS Manip has been patched not to work anymore. In the run you have to make quick decisions and choose whether to and how to kill each random encounter you find. You hope to get good encounters and stats along the way and in the end Final boss decides who wins
categories.name: Any% (No QS Manip)

games.description: FF1 is the first installment of one of the most iconic JRPG series. In this game you choose a role for four characters and save the world and the crystals. I would be playing the Pixel Remaster version that was released on PC in 2021 and on Switch and PS4 in 2023. In the pixel remaster version, there are auto-saves at every screen transition making the game very marathon friendly.
games.name: Final Fantasy

categories.description: 2 Player Coop, beat the game as fast as possible. Hidden warp allowed.
categories.name: Any% (2 Player)

games.description: Hippety hip, hippety hop! Help these two climb to the top! Rattle n Roll are just two snakes that want to get to space but a giant foot stands in their way. To beat it, you must lick it. A classically difficult, isometric game by Rare for the NES with a snazzy soundtrack by David Wise.
games.name: Snake Rattle n Roll

categories.description: Beat the game as fast possible featuring both simulation and action stages.  Essentially it's story mode but we barely have time to attend to the peasantry.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Classic early SNES title by Quintet/Enix that uniquely combined two genres into one game. The master and angel must rebuild towns like a fantasy Sim City then fly down from the heavens and take on monsters in action/platforming stages. The town building comes down to fast menuing and mashing while the platforming requires precise slash jumps, wall clipping, damage boosting and being hopeful that Stardust RNG won't be a Star"bust". One of Yuzo Koshiro's musical masterpieces.
games.name: ActRaiser

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible
categories.name: Any%

games.description: In this sequel to Contra, the alien invasion is back once again and it's up to us to blast and mash our way through 8 stages of pure action.
games.name: Super C

categories.description: The goal is to complete the Race Tour by winning all the Grand Prix tournaments (1 for each class). This involves starting from a fresh file and follow the path of the races leading up to the GP in order to move on to the next class.
categories.name: Race Tour Any%

games.description: Heavy traffic, blasting rock music and smashing opponents left right and center is all you need to make a legendary racing game! Extremely arcade, even though it is straightforward to beat casually the game becomes challenging for speedruns as the game expects you to crash on a regular basis with the crowded traffic, high speed of the cars and the agressiveness of the opponents.
games.name: Burnout 3: Takedown

categories.description: The goal is to win the World Rally Championship on the lowest difficulty setting (less stages required) with one of the cars available at the start of the game (aka the cars from the 2000 WRC season). 8 rallyes to complete with 4 stages per rally, occasional super specials and a lot of shortcuts!
categories.name: Championship (Novice, Standard Cars)

games.description:
Based off the World Rally Championship and its at the time star driver Colin McRae, it remains one of the most known and appreciated rally games ever made. The game also has great potential for speedrunning with a great diversity of surfaces and landscapes, skill-rewarding special stages and a lot of skips and glitches thanks to a faulty checkpoint system.
NB: out of all my submissions IMO it is the one where I am the most competent at and the most interesting run to showcase
games.name: Colin McRae Rally 2.0

categories.description: The goal is to complete all 24 licence tests with 1 different player per test. Signups would be opened at the event with 1 or 2 consoles in the practise room to train the licence tests the entire week. To pass the test you need to beat the bronze time without putting all 4 wheels in the grass
categories.name: All Licences (24-People Relay)

games.description: The most successful game of the PlayStation and one of the best advertisement for the console as well as for the DualShock controller. A lot of licenced cars and fictional tracks that went on to be more popular among fans than some real tracks was the beginning of a very succesful franchise.
games.name: Gran Turismo

categories.description: The goal is to get the Gold Symbol in the Battle Dome. for that we need to win through 10 rounds in a row of the facility, one round being a 16-players single elimination bracket tournament. You will face the facility leader Dome Ace Tucker in the final of Round 10.
categories.name: Battle Dome (Gold, Lv50)

games.description: The "final version" of gen 3, expanding the content of Ruby/Sapphire, mainly with what is interesting us here aka the Battle Frontier. Expansion of the already seen Battle Tower, the Frontier has 6 extra facilities (Dome, Palace, Arena, Pike, Factory and Pyramid) and added leaders to each of them. Those challenges are difficult for a casual player and considerably extends the lifespan of the game.
games.name: Pokémon Emerald

categories.description: The goal is to beat the game in Normal difficulty, which implies beating 10 stages + a boss on every planet of the solar system (without Mercury that is only played on Hard, but with Pluto which was still a planet in 1999) to save Earth from the alien invasion. Each planet has its signature enemy.
categories.name: Earth% (Normal)

games.description:
"Modern" remake of the 1978 arcade classic, it keeps the base 2D gameplay of the aliens scrolling faster and faster until reaching the bottom of the screen. However, many things were added including power-ups, special shots, music and a scenery and even boss fights! Beating the game unlocks the classic 1978 Space Invaders.
NB: Audio crashed on my PB run so it cannot showcase it there, but this game has a very good soundtrack I recommend checking it out
games.name: Space Invaders (1999)

categories.description: Hard mode increases the difficulty of the already brutal hotline 2 experience by flipping each screen upside down and adding more enemies, increasing the reaction time of those enemies, changing level layouts and halving the ammo of each gun every time you pick one up.
categories.name: Hard Mode

games.description: Never seen before in a marathon, hard mode in Hotline 2 is the most brutal hotline experience one can endure. The game loves to play pranks on it's runners with various mechanics that don't quite work as well as they should, and with kaizo-like levels of difficulty in a lot of places, it lends itself to being a entertaining experience to watch despite the pain it may inflict on the person playing
games.name: Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number

categories.description:
This category shows off the absolute peak of UtK2 skill. Each operation needs to be performed at max rank which usually means you can't make any mistakes.
There will be some operation re-dos for making a mistake. Worst case I can always skip an operation and come back to it later if estimate allows.
categories.name: All XS

games.description:
It's the fourth entry to Trauma center series and the second for the DS. It's a surgery simulator game focused on precision. It starts with simple operations you could imagine happen in real life and later veers off into curing aliens out of patients lungs.
Gameplay is touch screen based which is used to suture wounds, laser or cut out tumors etc.
Best appreciated with an optional hand cam if possible since we are using two DS styluses to showcase the ambidexterity
games.name: Trauma Center: Under the Knife 2

categories.description: For the first 6 worlds the goal is to beat the level while grabbing a collectible that is usually hidden in obscure and funny locations. This unlocks the final 9 levels that are filled with hard and weird platforming challenges and/or bossfights
categories.name: Any% true ending

games.description: Tobari is a cute platformes which is a mesh of mario and kirby of going right, stomping on enemies but also whacking the enemies with tobaris staff to aquire spells(abilities). The game has various abilities ranging from various simple projectile damage speels to double jumps to a bouncy ball around the character that is fast but hell to control. Overall a cute game that starts out easy and ends fairly difficult.
games.name: Tobari and the Night of the Curious moon

categories.description:
The default category where every operation is performed on normal difficulty or above where it is faster. This category is ~60% gameplay and ~40% story cutscenes.
The most consistent category for the game where it shows off how little we have to care about the patient as we go for speed.
categories.name: Normal

games.description:
It's the fourth entry to Trauma center series and the second for the DS. It's a surgery simulator game focused on precision. It starts with simple operations you could imagine happen in real life and later veers off into curing aliens out of patients lungs.
Gameplay is touch screen based which is used to suture wounds, laser or cut out tumors etc.
Best appreciated with an optional hand cam if possible since we are using two DS styluses to showcase the ambidexterity
games.name: Trauma Center: Under the Knife 2

categories.description: The simplest form of this speedgame. Go by level by level (Sometimes using secret exits to skip some levels) for 6 worlds and beat the final boss.
categories.name: Any% Normal ending

games.description:
This is the second Tobari game. There are a lot of improvements from the first game and is a lot less jank. It is still a mario meets kirby meets anime game where we stomp enemies and steal their powers in a cute anime art style.
The crutch that makes this game more fun as a speedgame is momentum preservation. As long as you hold right you maintain speed you gain from bouncing off of enemies which makes certain sections and entertaining blitz of speed
games.name: Tobari 2: Dream Ocean

categories.description: Beat the game as quickly as possible
categories.name: any%

games.description: A constantly-mutating, evolving virus has invaded the defense computer protecting the entire planet. You play as Colonel Scott O'Connor who has agreed to risk his life on an untested piece of technology.  Scott is converted to raw data and the computer sees that one of Scott's ancestors was a Kabuki actor combined with his fighting skills makes him the Kabuki Quantum Fighter! You must travel through the circuits of the defense computer and destroy the virus collecting weapons along the way.
games.name: Kabuki Quantum Fighter

categories.description: Beat the game as quickly as possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: I play as the ghost with the most! I will make my way into the Maitland House picking up key items, collecting scares, stomping bugs, and scaring those pesky Deetzs out of the house. This game was programmed by Rare, Inc. and distributed by LJN, so you get to hear some hot jams by David Wise. I will show off some cool skips, screen scrolling manipulation, and an assortment of scares seen in the movie like the birdman scare and umbrella scares while making my way to the Afterlife.
games.name: Beetlejuice

categories.description: beat the game as quickly as possible. 100% execution
categories.name: any%

games.description: Aliens have taken over planet Earth! You play as a ninja that has been in the shadows training endlessly until your ninja skills are needed! You run through various terrains either a ninja or you can transform into an animal to race through the levels ending in a battle against the leader of the alien forces. The run is a little silly but super fun to play and watch.
games.name: Ninja Crusaders

categories.description: beat the game as quickly as possible, zips are allowed. This time is likely to be improved before ESA.
categories.name: any%

games.description: You play as Inspector Hart to stop an evil organization that performs evil experiments on humans. This organization is just a front for an alien race which is hellbent on taking over the world. You must fight a series of mutated human monsters leading to a final showdown against the B.E.D.A. corporation's director. The game consists of Spy Hunter like driving stages, Punisher style gallery shooting stages, and many Ninja Gaiden like platforming stages. It has tons of tech &is a cool, slick run.
games.name: Vice: Project Doom

categories.description: Beat the game as quickly as possible. One wrong warp is utilized in stage 1.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Streemerz is a remake/reimagining of the Action 52 game of the same name. You play as Joe, a member of STREEMERZ, who had sabotaged the V6-15D and has to evacuate Master Y's headquarters. He uses his streemer to propel his way through Master Y's headquarters past obstacles, henchmen, and other hazards. The game is fast paced, the movement is fluid and quick, and is reminiscent of Bionic Commando. You can't jump you can only use your streemer which makes for some fun movement.
games.name: Streemerz

categories.description: As the former WR holder for the category, I've been working in secret developing a much more refined route for the run, and I'd love to debut it at ESA Summer 2024! It consists of acquiring 6000 total gems, 50 dragons and 5 eggs to make it through the game, with a massive sequence break at the end.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Spyro the Dragon is a 1998 3D Collectathon platformer that stars Spyro on his journey to rescue his dragon elders imprisoned in crystal statues, rescue the stolen treasure and recover the stolen baby dragon eggs. Fast paced, technical movement is used throughout  with very fast, seamless loading screens that make for an amazing speedrun viewing experience.
games.name: Spyro the Dragon

categories.description: The run consists of gathering enough Gems and Dragonflies to reach 70% completion, at which the final boss portal (located 5ft from the start of the game) opens up and the final (and only) boss can be defeated. Various janky skips and lagclips are used throughout.
categories.name: Any% (No Early Ripto)

games.description: This game is awful. Rushed out the door for the holidays in 2002, this game is riddled with broken animations, janky hit detection, super easy clips/skips and some of the weirdest cutscenes you've ever seen. The game consists of your standard Spyro fare, running around collecting gems and this time freeing the scattered Dragonflies with your new bubble breath ability.
games.name: Spyro: Enter the Dragonfly

categories.description: Bingo Time Attack is a way to play bingo I thought about to be more consistent for marathons, instead beating the game or do X bingos in the fastest time, we get a fixed timer of 3 hours and have to do as many objectives we can. With a punishment for each missing objective at the end of course.
categories.name: Bingo Time Attack

games.description: One of the best RPG of the GBA, but with a twist, all items gets randomized, and we got the ship from the start ! Get to play that RPG with a Metroidvania feel. The bingo take 25 objectives from a pool of more that 100 and gets us all around this newly opened world to try and get other ways to enjoy the game.
games.name: Golden Sun : The Lost Age

categories.description:
No Major Glitches, Yes Major Fun!
Relive the original version of the game, without skipping loads of it!
categories.name: Any% No Major Glitches

games.description:
The best selling PS2 game ever, in one of the best selling game series ever.
Now for the first time played on an original PS2 instead of the PC version!
There's loads of differences!
games.name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas

categories.description:
The latest segments of the mod to be completed!
Estimate is subject to change as the mod is still in development, but this segment will be finished by the time of ESA.
categories.name: Badlands + San Fierro

games.description: Tightened'reas is the latest in a series of hard mode mods for speedrunners for San Andreas. It's currently in development and I'm working with DinosaurBytes on it and this submission. I'll have an early version featuring a finished and polished Badlands + San Fierro segment. Estimate is subject to change
games.name: Grand Theft Auto: Tightened'Reas

categories.description: Thanks to a new discovery last year we can now use memory manipulation in Crash Bash to bypass the requirements to enter the boss levels. The run effectively turns into a boss rush which allows the game to be beaten comically quickly.
categories.name: Any% (Memory Manipulation)

games.description: Infamous party spin-off of the Crash Bandicoot series that must be very well-known to most ESA staff by now.
games.name: Crash Bash

categories.description: This category tackles the story mode of the game, completing specific tasks across 8 tracks. Usually it involves achieving a specific race result, collecting objects on the track or successfully using certain items a number of times.
categories.name: All Missions

games.description: Crash Bandicoot mobile racing game with a small story mode.  Fairly inoffensive game with a few nice challenges to complete that go beyond just winning races. Played on a Nokia N95 with the possibility for capture via composite-output cables. Strictly speaking not a game for the actual N-Gage (the system) but a part of the N-Gage 2.0 (the service). Pretty much a tradition that I try to submit this game at this point.
games.name: Crash Bandicoot Nitro Kart 3D

categories.description: any% allows warps, both intended hidden warps and unintended warps.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Plok is a rather obscure and underrated Platformer where you shoot your limbs out to fight fleas. Involves challenging platforming, some cool boss fights and a few gimmicky vehicles to control. Also has an absolutely amazing soundtrack by the Follin brothers.
games.name: Plok

categories.description: only category, no restrictions
categories.name: any%

games.description: Skyblazer is a hidden gem on the SNES, a really solid platformer with good controls and fun boss fights. You gain magic spells including a dash that is used a lot in the run. Speedrun tech includes zips and drop manipulations to refill magic for more dash usage. The game also has several autoscrollers which would be perfect for donations or other announcements.
games.name: Skyblazer

categories.description: 2 Loop category for the real ending. In the second loop enemies and projectiles are faster and some enemies act a bit differently.
categories.name: any% NES (2 loops)

games.description: Ghosts 'n Goblins is  one of the most infamous NES games, released really early in the NES lifespan and known for its' difficulty. It is a platformer with kinda clunky controls and a lot of easy ways to die thanks to only having 2 hits. Unlike later entries in the series there is no double jump or magic to help navigating the levels. The speedrun uses several damage boosts to skip parts of stages.
games.name: Ghosts 'n Goblins

categories.description: Major Glitches are not allowed. Those include a death glitch and OoB glitches
categories.name: any% No Major Glitches

games.description: Ultima 8 is a DOS-RPG from 1994 and was not very popular with Ultima fans, probably because it is a bit lighter on the RPG elements and instead has (kinda janky) platforming. The speedrun is almost a pacifist run and does a lot of stuff out of order or skips it completely with cool tricks like using blankets to cross a lava river and abusing the magic spells available.
games.name: Ultima VIII: Pagan

categories.description: standard any% category on the US version, everything is allowed
categories.name: any%

games.description: Kid icarus is a classic NES platformer from 1987. The player controls pit on his quest to gain three sacred treasures and save Angel Land from Medusa. The game features pretty challenging vertical and side scrolling platforming and maze-like boss stages. The speedrun uses wall clips to skip huge parts of the mazes (and one of the bosses) and manipulates certain enemies and platforms for faster patterns. There are also screen wraps involving playing stages basically without seeing ahead
games.name: Kid Icarus

categories.description: While twitch chat can put hurdles in the way, we will try to beat the game as fast as possible. With two tricks that allow us to fly through the map and also launch ourselves into the world, we can make sure to pass the maps very quickly.

The run contains a lot of cool looking movement speedtech such as Dodging for general traversal and Bhops to conserve momentum, as well as ways to break the game completely and skip whole maps such as Save Hovering and Death Clipping.

The same movement tricks and major glitches apply as in the base game, and while developed by a different team, holds up to the main game in terms of level design, atmosphere and combat!

games.description: SCED-02417 is the name of a popular PlayStation 1 demo disc. Essentially before some games were released, demo discs would come out alongside magazines, cereal boxes and such,  where you could play a short demo of upcoming releases. SCED-02417 is a late 1999 demo disc for the PS1 and has Bug's Bunny: Lost in Time, Crash Team Racing, Croc 2, Destrega, Devil Dice, Gran Turismo 2, Ridge Racer Type 4, Spyro 2, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, and Wip3out. All absolute bangers.
games.name: SCED-02417 Demo Disc

We have 2 PCs, both with Flashpoint Infinity open (A program that hosts flash games) and while the first run is taking place, the second run will be setting up.
categories.name: Any%?

games.description: This is going to be a showcase of 27 flash games in the span of an hour and 20 minutes, all run by different people! Some of the games are extremely goofy, some of the games are very nostalgic, and some of the games are just straight up impressive runs.  The list of runs can be found here. https://pastebin.com/ipcSf2bz Total the estimates add up to 1:04:15, but just to be on the safe side I am submitting under 1:20:00, incase of tech problems, big mistakes in peoples runs and endings.
