categories.description: In Any% we play as Digo who's the fastest character and hope to get the mythical "BIG URN" the best item you can get in the item crates that almost quadruples your speed.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Monster Racer is a PAL only racing game released for the PS1 in 2001 by Microids. It's overall a pretty poor casual game but has a ton of comedic relief and a cult following in speedrunning. I would say this is prime second stream content.
games.name: Monster Racer

categories.description: The submission link is a placeholder until i record my own run. feel free to contact me on discord. This cat has a couple cool tricks (for example a longshot clip at 1:06 in the video) but overall i feel like the audience would most likely enjoy seeing the game and all of its little details:)
categories.name: any%

games.description: This is an adventure mode mod with astounding attention to detail. The whole game is essentially recreated (even the music). When i first saw this run i was pretty blown away by how cool it looks. Being a long time oot runner myself, this is great fun. For a marathon, this run definitely belongs into the 2nd category from the submission guide. It will allow me to be funny and engaging, while the game is probably a comfy stream 2 experience:)
games.name: Ocarina of Time in Minecraft 1.0.3

categories.description: The run becomes a hilarious 3 minutes of walking on empty space and then glitching into a house to press the event blocks to teleport you to the final boss after you finish deku tree. so if you will, 1.0.3 is glitchless oot while this is basically a wrong warp.
categories.name: any%

games.description: The game is in principle the same as above but the run is entirely different on a lower patch. N64 OoT viewers will thoroughly enjoy this
games.name: Ocarina of Time in Minecraft 1.0.1

categories.description: In NG+ you start the game with a dash mechanic which makes the game go lightning speed right from the beginning. Just like in Hotline, you can instantly respawn and try again if you die so there is no downtime. The game is super short too so once you start getting bored its already over ;)
categories.name: NG+

games.description: Super fun Hotline Miami-esque fpshooter where you play as a guy who is angry and likes to kick people to the sound of hardbass. Unfortunately, the real game release has been delayed by a lot, so i find myself coming back to one of the two demo versions that exist until now. I keep repeating myself but this is super fast-paced and fun. Also enemies dance with you when youre dead 8)
games.name: Anger Foot (itch.io)

categories.description: Using the same engine as its predecessor, Chronicles also abuses remote triggering by using the binoculars. The run may be best known for its two segments where Lara is intentionally set on fire and has to constantly be healed for minutes, all for the sake of avoiding cutscenes and death triggers.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The tale of TR5's development is as tragic as it is frustrating, as the developers were bound by contractual obligations to create a game they never intended to. The result is a game that is regarded by many as the black sheep of the classic Tomb Raiders, plagued by an abundance of unskippable cutscenes and retconning many aspects of established TR lore. While speedruns of this game were considered as "Popcorn%" because of the many cutscenes, many of them can be entirely skipped by now.
games.name: Tomb Raider: Chronicles

categories.description: TR4 Any% has become the shortest classic TR run only a few years ago, when the possibility to skip multiple levels was found. This requires an intricate setup of save files being created in specific levels and locations, skipping from halfway into the game all the way to the (abrupt) end.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The fourth entry in the classic Tomb Raider franchise introduced numerous features  and mechanics that on one hand clearly separated it from the the original trilogy of games. It is by far the longest and classic TR game, with the ability and requirement to revisit levels multiple times with newly obtained items and much more advanced puzzles to solve. The speedrun on the other hand heavily abuses the new binoculars to hit a variety of triggers across the map, completely inverting this premise.
games.name: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation

categories.description: The Restricted category tries to preserve the feel of the "old" Any% route as much as possible, banning the relatively newly found save warps. This means that the second half including the intended end of the game is included, as is the iconic part of Lara being set on fire for 10 minutes.
categories.name: Restricted

games.description: The fourth entry in the classic Tomb Raider franchise introduced numerous features  and mechanics that on one hand clearly separated it from the the original trilogy of games. It is by far the longest and classic TR game, with the ability and requirement to revisit levels multiple times with newly obtained items and much more advanced puzzles to solve. The speedrun on the other hand heavily abuses the new binoculars to hit a variety of triggers across the map, completely inverting this premise.

Sega loved Lizardcube's remake on Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap that they accepted their pitch on a Streets of Rage sequel.
26 years after the release of Streets of Rage 3, the iconic gang are back 10 years older but with a lot more tools at their disposal from cancels to juggles and even infinites.
If you want a mad co-op run with 3-4 players, this will get bonkers.

games.description:
Soul of the Samurai, released as Ronin Blade in Europe, is an action-adventure game developed and published by Konami in 1999 for the PlayStation.
From the start the player chooses to be either a young male ronin named Kotaro or a teenage female ninja named Lin (Rin). From then on he or she travels through prerendered levels, killing enemies and fulfilling their mission.
games.name: Soul of the Samurai

categories.description: This category aims to complete the game as quickly as possible on the easiest difficulty, while playing as Lu Yunchuan. After the tutorial we complete a short sidequest along the way to gain early access to "Blood Spell", an ability that lets us do massive (stagger) damage while we are at low health
categories.name: Any% Lu Yunchuan NG Casual

games.description: Eastern Exorcist is a stunning 2D side-scrolling action RPG set in a fantasy eastern world with vicious spirits and monsters. Players take control of one of two characters to fight against chaotic evil in a brutal world, and experience different stories of joy and sorrow.
games.name: Eastern Exorcist

categories.description:
It's DD with CC. What could ever go wrong?!
(Side effects of this showcase include: The runner losing their sanity. The commentators spontaneously dying. The host being inflicted by an ancient curse. The tech crew abandoning ship when it matters most. Money being raised for charity)
categories.name: Crowd Control

games.description: Darkest Dungeon is a roguelike role-playing video game developed and published by Red Hook Studios. The player manage a roster of heroes to explore dungeons below a gothic mansion the player has inherited. Played out in a mix of real-time movement and turn-based combat, a core feature of Darkest Dungeon is the stress level of each hero that increases with further exploration and combat; a character sustaining a high-stress level may gain afflictions that will hamper their performance.
games.name: Darkest Dungeon

categories.description: This is the "bad ending"-category of TLF - which also happens to be the fastest ending - played on the most recent patch. Since MOST glitches have been patched out, fast clears rely on optimal movement and skill against the various bosses.
categories.name: Any% 1.5.2 Hail to the King

games.description: Bloodborne goes Metroidvania' in this 2D pixelgraphic indie horror game. Step into The Last Faith’s ravaged world as Eryk, who awakens with no recollection of his immediate past. Soon he will discover he is in a race against time as his mind and conscience begins to deteriorate. His desire for salvation from this affliction sets him on a cursed mission that crosses paths with ancient religions and divinities.
games.name: The Last Faith

categories.description: This category aims to complete all of the game's main quests on the easiest difficulty setting ('Dawn'). Gameplay alternates between quickly navigating the open world to the next mission and then blitzing through those.
categories.name: Any% Dawn

games.description:
Embark on an epic journey across war-torn 19th-century Japan in this combat-focused open-world action RPG from Team NINJA, the veteran studio behind Nioh and NINJA GAIDEN.
Japan, 1863. After three centuries of the Tokugawa Shogunate’s reign, the Black Ships of the West descend upon the nation’s borders and the country falls into a state of turmoil. Amidst the chaos of war, disease and political unrest, a nameless warrior forges their own path, holding the very fate of Japan in their hands.
games.name: Rise of the Ronin

categories.description: Standard Any% definition applies. Complete the game as fast as possible, in any means possible, without any cheats.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory is a stealth-action game, where you play as Sam Fisher, the elite secret operative tasked with saving the world for the third time... in under an hour! However, the run goes beyond both "stealth" and "action" to deliver a speedrun full of movement, dialogue skipping, rather clunky AI moments, and of course - some refined humour, presented by the world's top spy.
games.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Chaos Theory

categories.description: Standard Any% definition applies. Complete the game as fast as possible, in any means possible, without any cheats.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow is a stealth-action game that sees the return of Sam Fisher, the elitest of elite spies (of all time, of course), as he is tasked with saving the world again. But he is in a hurry, so much so, that he's going to do it in under an hour! Tune in as we follow Sam's adventures, all full of fast movement, cinematic explosions, level-skipping out-of-bounds, and absolute disregard for both "stealth" and "action". And a slight hint of some sweet humour!
games.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow

categories.description: Standard Any% definition applies. Complete the game as fast as possible, in any means possible, without any cheats.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell tells the story of Sam Fisher, a top-secret agent tasked with saving the world from total catastrophy. However, this time around he's prepared to waste no time and do it all in an hour! Tune in as this stealth-action video game challenges its genre with action-packed gameplay, sequence breaks, out-of-bounds tech, and most importantly - keeps everyone on their toes.
games.name: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell

games.description: This run is for the arcade game Journey of the Prairie King that exists within Stardew Valley. The game has 13 stages, including 3 bosses, in 3 areas. The goal is to shoot all spawning enemies without touching them, as that kills you. There is no leader board for this arcade game, but I think it might be fun to show off. Beating this game without dying once grants an achievement that less than 2% of players have gotten so far. And only about 0.2% without save scumming.
games.name: Stardew Valley

categories.description: In 100% we collect all upgrades, hearts, etanks and ride armors. On top of that we get the golden armor and the z-saber to finish the game

games.description: Mega Man X3 is the final release on the SNES. In classic platformer fashion we beat our way through all kind of stages, collect stuff and beat the bad guys.
games.name: Mega Man X3

categories.description: In the 100% trifecta we collect every collectable of each game including upgrades, hearts, containers and secret weapons and finishing the games then
categories.name: 100% Trrifecta

games.description: Mega Man X1-3 are platformers all released on the SNES. In this run beat each game back to back
games.name: Mega Man X1-3

categories.description: Every game is played with any% rules where everything is allowed to beat the games as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any% fecta

games.description: The gameboy megaman are platformers just like their classic counterpart. In these games you usually have a mix of robots from 2 different nes megamans except rockman world 5 where everything is unique. In this run we try to beat every game back to back.
games.name: Rockman World 1-5

categories.description: In any% we dont collect any extras and just try to beat the game  as fast as possible even though we collect 4 letters along the way to progress the game.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Rockman World 4 is the forth release on the gameboy and has a mix of robotmasters from mm4 and 5 from the nes. In classic platformer way we make our way through 8+ stages and get Dr. Wily in the end.
games.name: Rockman World 4

categories.description: In the 100% category we collect all upgrades, hearts, etanks and the secret weapon the hadouken. After that we beat the game the intended way

games.description: Mega Man X is a platformer and the first release on the snes. This run contains alot of precise movement and tricks like the iceless jump to get a heart early on or the famous magic carpet.
games.name: Mega Man X1

categories.description: You're tasked with completing the game by only collecting the 14 required talismans at the end of every level, skipping optional orbs, and utilizing a plethora of out-of-bounds tricks and very rapid-fire movement!
categories.name: 14 Talisman

games.description: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! follows Spyro's quest to save Avalar from the villainous Ripto. He collects talismans across diverse realms, gains new abilities, and interacts with quirky characters. With vibrant visuals and engaging gameplay, it's a beloved classic in PlayStation history.
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: Any% is an insanely fun category to watch. There's a massive amount of funny-looking tricks and widely interesting movement tech like Journal Launch, Air Walking, etc. It's also a fantastic game for incentives!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Uncharted 2 follows treasure hunter Nathan Drake on a quest for the fabled Cintamani Stone. With exhilarating action, breathtaking visuals, and compelling storytelling, Drake navigates through perilous landscapes, facing off against mercenaries and unraveling ancient mysteries. The game's seamless blend of platforming, gunplay, and puzzle-solving creates an unforgettable adventure.
games.name: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves

categories.description:
Any% in this game consists of either rapidly navigating Spider-Man's web-swinging or clipping through everything imaginable to hit the end-of-level trigger hidden underneath the maps!
I will also wear a Spider-Man suit during the run!
categories.name: Any% (Easy)

games.description:
Spider-Man PS1 is full of very rapid mid-air movement and 'blink and you miss it' out-of-bounds tricks! This game hasn't gotten a lot of time on the big screen and I genuinely think this being showcased would turn a lot of heads! 
One of the highlights of the run is that the last section is a stressful chase level from the final boss that would get a lot of the audience glued to the run.  Also, Any% allows 3 different costumes, so we can have donation incentives for people's favorite suit!
games.name: Spider-Man (2000)

categories.description: I consider 100 Egg to be the beginner's category for Spyro 3 running! The goal is to collect 100 Eggs in a very specific/optimized route and get to the final boss as fast as possible! People are VERY familiar with this game, so seeing it represented at all would bring in a large crowd!
categories.name: 100 Egg

games.description: This game continues the adventures of the beloved purple dragon as he sets out to recover stolen dragon eggs. Across vibrant worlds, Spyro confronts enemies, solves puzzles, and completes challenges. With diverse gameplay including platforming, mini-games, and character-switching, it offers a rich, colorful experience. Collectibles, secret areas, and charming characters add depth to this classic PlayStation platformer.
games.name: Spyro: Year of the Dragon

categories.description: This is the one and only category for this game. No glitches to skip parts of the game, but there is a dev-intended door to skip the last part of the first level, saving about a minute or two. The run can be done in just under 7 minutes, but my average marathon time is 7:30 - 8 minutes.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
This game is peak NES, having won Worst Sequel of 1992 and Worst Movie-to-Game of 1996 by Electronic Gaming Monthly. It is a side-scrolling platformer in which you control Kevin as you run and shoot your way through the levels. Enemies consist of jumping grandmas, suitcases, hotel personnel who choke Kevin on contact, and of course the Sticky Bandits. It is a surprisingly decent speedrun. The movement quite fluid and good, and the speedrun is low on glitches
Commentator: thebagler5
games.name: Home Alone 2

categories.description:
The warpless category plays the game without using any warp whistles or wrong warps. You skip all the levels you can by either taking a certain route on the overworld map or using the cloud item.
If possible, this could be a relay race with 8 people, each doing 1 world.
categories.name: Warpless

games.description: I think everyone knows what this game is.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. 3

categories.description: Any% plays all the regular levels and skips 2 basketball mini-games. Every normal stage gives you a time machine part, which you'll need to get to the final level. The run is just under 15 minutes run, but my average marathon time is between 15 and 16 minutes.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Yes, this is the 7 GRAND DAD game. It's a side-scrolling action platformer in which you control Fred to club a bunch of prehistoric animals. Platforming wise there's a challenge in never stopping to move, which forces you to attack mid-air as much as you can. Other than that it's a pretty vanilla, but fun speedrun. The most notable glitches in this game are a club power glitch and an oversight on the elevators in the final level, allowing you to clip your way to the final boss.
games.name: The Flintstones: The Rescue of Dino & Hoppy

categories.description: The only main category of the game. You skip most of the first level by using a double jump glitch only available in the first level The rest of the game is all about quickly making your way through the levels while grabbing all the necessary force powers. Vader at the end is mostly RNG lol
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
This is one of those NES games that are incredibly hard and unfair casually. It is very loosely based on the movie of the same name. The run itself consists of a lot of jumping because it's faster than normal running. In all of the levels you're either platforming of flying in your X-wing ship while shooting stuff down. There are several glitches in the game which either skip parts of a level or skips some of the waiting or slowing down you are supposed to be doing.
Commentator: thebagler5
games.name: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back

categories.description:
This is the 'standard' category.  You play through all the levels as fast as possible. No glitches to skip parts. 
There are some changes to enemy HP / attack damage which makes this category a bit longer than the NTSC-J one.
categories.name: NTSC-U (Any%)

games.description:
The second NES Turtles game, very different from the first one, but this game is more like the sequels.
It's a Beat-em-up where most of the being fast comes from just killing the enemies quickly. The boss fights rely more on good setups to prevent getting hit or sent flying. Very low on glitches.
games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Arcade Game

categories.description: Good Ending is almost a 100% category. You get all upgrades, clear all missions and get most of the collectibles in order to trigger the Good Ending of the game. To help me cover the run I will have Naro commentate with me - making this category a perfect fit for the Touhou block!
categories.name: Good Ending

games.description:
Daichan no Daibouken: ~ Sekaihoukai ~ End of World (Daichan End of World for short) is a Japanese 3D Touhou platforming game that plays like a blend of Super Mario 64, Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time and Banjo Kazooie.
During the game you roll around collecting upgrades like the double jump that can be utilized with a glitch to jump super far!
The game has a lot of interesting skips and optimized routing that makes for a surprisingly great speed game!
games.name: Daichan no Daibouken: ~ Sekaihoukai ~ End of World

categories.description: in Any% No Pause Buffer the use of "Pause Buffer" is banned - a broken glitch that can allow you skip some levels entirely. This means there is a higher focus on movement and utilizing multiple skips to get through levels fast. During the run ChZDK will help commentate the game with me :)
categories.name: Any% No Pause Buffer

games.description: Sonic Omens is a 3D fan game made by a small studio called Ouroboros Studios. The game plays like a mix of the Boost Sonic games and the Sonic Adventure games and has a variety of different gameplay styles. It's a intense high speed game with tight platforming and lots of momentum based movement. A lot of stages have incredibly broken skips that has you going out of bounds, flying over giant gaps and generally just breaking the game in multiple fun ways :3 (It also has an amazing soundtrack)
games.name: Sonic Omens

categories.description: Any% has you starting from a fresh file meaning you need to collect bolts in order to progress the game and unlike in NG+ you cannot rely on the PDA to break the game until near the end. This means there are Any% exclusive skips for certain levels and a general focus on movement without the PDA.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Ratchet & Clank is a action platforming game that takes you on a adventure through the galaxy and is the origin story to one of the most beloved Playstation mascots of all time. A lot of the movement in the game looks super cool and requires really precise inputs which makes for a overal impressive run. During the game we gain ridiculous amounts of speed, fly over water, control the game during cutscenes and break the game in many fun and interesting ways all while listening to banger tracks.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank

categories.description: Any% Restricted bans some of the tech in the game that allows you to skip giant portions of levels. This puts a bigger focus on the actual movement of the game, which is one of it's big selling points and also really satisfying to watch. It's a really straight forward and visually appealing run!
categories.name: Any% Restricted

games.description:
Penny's Big Breakaway is a brand new 3D Platformer from the creators of Sonic Mania that puts you into the shoes of Penny, getting through stages with her YoYo!
This game actually came out during Kyrrone's run at ESA Winter 2024, whom also will assist me with commentary for this run :) Apologies for the gameplay in the submission video - I put the estimate a bit higher now and I'll make sure to do a ton of prep if the run gets in! - I really want this game to make it into this ESA! ^_^
games.name: Penny's Big Breakaway

categories.description: Sonic's Story is the main story of the game that is unlocked from the very beginning. Sonic's Story utilizes Sonic's "Spindash" to go way faster than intended, jump massive gaps and clip out of bounds to skip entire levels! I will have another Sonic's Story runner ChZdk help me commentate the run :)
categories.name: Sonic's Story

games.description: Sonic Adventure DX is one of the first 3D Sonic platformers of all time! At ESA Summer 23 I participated in the relay for the game where I played Big's Story, but I have put a lot more time into Sonic's Story which I would love to showcase! :) My good friend ChZdk has also submitted Amy's Story, so if it comes down to it I'd prefer his run making it in over mine - he's fought very hard to get the category into ESA, so it would mean a lot to me to see it finally happen! ^_^
games.name: Sonic Adventure DX: Director's Cut

categories.description: Finish the game as fast as possible and defeat Jibril, the secret head angel of the angel police.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Go Go Ackman 3 is a side-scrolling action game where players control Ackman, a demon assassin, on a quest to retrieve souls for his father, the Devil. The game features fast-paced platforming and combat elements across multiple levels.
games.name: Go Go Ackman 3

categories.description: Defeat the final boss. Previously a lot of routing for this category revolved around finding the fastest xp, but with xp duplication, that has almost been eliminated. Now clean movement and combat takes center stage, and a bit of luck from gear drops keeps things spicy!
categories.name: Kill Ranrok

games.description:
HL was the best selling game of 2023. It's an open-world adventure, set in 1890's Hogwarts, where you're a student starting your 5th year at the school.
Though our community for speedrunning the game isn't largem a plethera of tricks, glitches and strats has been found and used when running, including OOB, menu glitches, xp duplication and fight skips/quick kills, as well as optimization for gear to maximize damage. For commentary I would have Deano95 and perhaps Gerdi.
games.name: Hogwarts Legacy

categories.description:
Mario and Luigi alternate turns to complete every level in the game, including enemies that appear on the map like hammer bros.
Each player will collect different items along the way, so we will have to efficiently manage our inventory, powerup and level routing.
categories.name: 100% Coop

games.description: Being the first Mario title to feature a P-Speed mechanic, this game puts even more emphasis on building and mantaining your blistering speed throughout each level, with a handful of wall clipping tech sprinkled in.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. 3

categories.description: The goal is to complete all levels while collecting every hidden super mushroom. Each mushroom increases your maximum HP by 1 until the end of the level. This allows new damage boosting strats to be used, as well as featuring different routes and character choices that are unique to this category.
categories.name: All Powerup Mushrooms

games.description: Choose your player! In this adventure, Mario is joined by his brother Luigi, Princess Toadstool and Toad. Each character has their own unique movement abilities, including Mario who is good at being average. This game puts the player's platforming skills to test, featuring climbing sections, double jump tech, a couple floor clips, a good dose of digging and some clever use of items to fight certain bosses quicker.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. 2

categories.description: No zips allowed, beat the alien
categories.name: Any% Zipless

games.description: Jump and shoot - go fast no zips - dont die - massive gaming
games.name: Mega Man 2

categories.description: Any% is the fastest and most popular category
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Mirror's Edge is a cult-classic parkour game from 2009. The game has some of the most unique movement mechanics and plenty of glitches that make the game perfect for speedrunning. The community keeps upping the ante by implementing more and more difficult tricks into the any% route that will be fun to attempt and hype if they work.
games.name: Mirror's Edge

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible. Timer starts when you select "NEW GAME" and ends when the first frame of the Godzilla and Mothra ending screen appears after leaving Planet X. Use of the "Death Warp" is NOT allowed. (Death Warp is a glitch which is used to skip levels)
categories.name: All Planets - Warpless

games.description: Traverse through the solar system as Godzilla and Mothra, defeating increasingly difficult and diverse enemy Kaiju on the way to King Ghidorah on Planet X. The gameplay involves strategically navigating overworld maps for each planet, where you kick, punch, and atomic breath your way through side scrolling levels and boss fights on the way to the command centers at the end of each world. Completing stages and defeating bosses levels up Godzilla and Mothra and increases their health and power.
games.name: Godzilla: Monster of Monsters

categories.description: Beat the game as quickly as possible on the English version of the game. Timing starts when you gain control of nemo (first movement in Mushroom Forest) and ends at loss of character control when the Nightmare King is defeated. No turbo allowed.
categories.name: English

games.description: "The game revolves around a young boy in his own surreal dreams as he journeys to Slumberland. Nemo can ride certain animals such as a frog, a gorilla, or a mole, by feeding them candy. Each animal has its own skills needed to complete each level. The purpose of the game is to travel to the Nightmare land to rescue Morpheus, the king of Slumberland, from the clutches of the evil Nightmare King. "
games.name: Little Nemo: The Dream Master

categories.description: Complete all 24 levels and defeat Ganon at the end of the game.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Despite what the length might have you think, FSA is an incredibly technical and flashy Zelda speedrun, featuring tricks such as clips, hovers and out of bounds. Exclusive to the game, you get to control and switch between four Link's simultaneously in a level based progression, making for many interesting sequence breaks throughout nearly every level. The run recently shaved off about 8 minutes in length thanks to a new way of clipping through walls being discovered earlier in the year.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords Adventures

categories.description: Beat the game while completing the most possible amount of levels in a single playthrough.
categories.name: Longest Path

games.description: Hook & jump, try to press the correct directions and fail miserably because the game is impossible
games.name: Umihara Kawase

categories.description: The game allows you to pick between Sonic and Tails. Tails can fly and gets different powerups throughout the stages, allowing for a lot of freedom of movement.
categories.name: Tails: Beat the Game

games.description: Sonic Triple Trouble is an 8bit handheld platformer for the Sega Game Gear. It is a largely glitchless and very movement and momentum focused run in classic 2D Sonic fashion but much different mechanics than the more popular 16bit games
games.name: Sonic Triple Trouble

categories.description: Sonic Any% is a category where you play the game as Sonic and beat the game as fast as possible! Sonic's core ability (The "Thok") sends him flying straight forward and leads to precise and speedy gameplay. We use many routes, skips and strategies to beat the game as fast as possible as Sonic.
categories.name: Sonic Any%

games.description: Sonic Robo Blast 2 (SRB2) is a Sonic fangame that is a mod of Doom. It's development dates all the way back to 1999. It's a 3D platformer that has been constantly improved and updated over the years.
games.name: Sonic Robo Blast 2

categories.description: This category consists of reaching the credits as fast as possible while exploiting the many glitches that are available throughout the game. We also have to be extra careful about the routing since there is a pretty big medal requirement to access the last levels of the game.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Sonic Unleashed is a 3D Sonic game featuring fast paced daytime levels played as Sonic and more combat oriented levels with the nighttime levels played as the Werehog.
This game is what started the "modern" series of Sonic games with the new ideas and abilities incorporated.
games.name: Sonic Unleashed

categories.description: The goal is to collect everything from its original source without the use of SRM (Stale Reference Manipulation) or ACE (Arbitrary Code Execution), this includes all hearts, items, max upgrades, gold skulltulas, songs etc.

games.description: One of the greatest games ever made, Ocarina of Time has the most insane glitches and speedrun strats that will blow away anyone who sees it.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

categories.description: The DLC takes the already exploitable combat system and makes it even crazier, which is why it is the most popular speedrun across the Xenoblade series.
categories.name: Any% Normal DLC

games.description: The best game of all time - according to me. The combat is very exploitable when you know what you're doing. Like any other JRPG there's also a ton RNG, but nothing we can't outplay with enough skill. There are also plenty of glitches to speed up the downtime in between fights.
games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 2

categories.description: This category starts off with an infinite flight glitch - the Zombie Jump - which then leads to a run full of abusing the combat system, as well as doing side quests for the Community system.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The DLC story for Xenoblade Chronicles 2, taking place 500 years before the base game and adding new characters and expanding upon the already existing mechanics.
games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 2: Torna ~ The Golden Country

categories.description: This run features mostly control of the protagonist, Matthew, who has a very fast paced combat style. We also use a ton of strong chain attacks, which is reliant of randomly being given specific characters, which is both a cause of frustration and comedy.
categories.name: Any% Normal

games.description: The finale to the numbered Xenoblade games and the DLC story for Xenoblade Chronicles 3, with new mechanics, lore and brutal, brutal RNG.
games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Future Redeemed

categories.description: Since we have to go into fights underlevelled, they can get very risky so we need to make sure we're doing enough damage to the enemies before they can do the damage to us, alternatively we can also keep them down with Topple and Daze arts.
categories.name: Any% Casual

games.description: The original Wii game, but put onto Switch with improved graphics alongside other improvements, such as the new Time Attack mode.
games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition

categories.description: It has the same objective as Any%, however we must also complete the story, meaning there are extra boss battles and story events, such as the New Donk City Festival
categories.name: World Peace

games.description: The most recent 3D Mario game, known for its fast-paced gameplay and amazing movement, everything else really goes without saying.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: Dark Side is the little brother of the generally speaking more popular category of Darker Side. In Dark Side the objective is to get 250 Moons as fast as possible and then finish the Dark Side of the moon. It has similar movement to Any% with some interesting new parts and even post game movement.
categories.name: Dark Side

games.description: Mario Odyssey is (still) the newest installation of the 3D Mario genre. With its intricate movement and phenomenal graphics (especially for the switch) it definitely counts towards the masterpieces of Nintendo in recent history and leads to a pleasing and satisfying speedrunning showcase on high level.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: Ending 10 is the equivalent of any% of Little Goody Two Shoes, being the faster category, not requiring any of the items that activates the other endings.
categories.name: Ending 10: Motherly Cocoon (any%)

games.description: Little Goody Two Shoes takes inspiration from the classic RPGmaker indie horror games, and takes it one step further, with a social sim aspect and resource management added onto it. Join Elise in her adventure to make her wishes come true. Will she be able to succeed at her goals?
games.name: Little Goody Two Shoes

categories.description: Sweet is the equivalent of easy difficulty for the No More Heroes franchise. The run itself is pretty straightforward, with no major glitches and abusing mainly the most powerful tools in Travis' kit.
categories.name: any% NG Sweet

games.description: No More Heroes 2: Desperate Struggle is the second entry of the No More Heroes franchise. Set 3 years after the events of the first game, Travis Touchdown will have to get to the top once again, this time pursuing vengeance for the death of his friend.
games.name: No More Heroes 2: Desperate Struggle

categories.description: Sweet is the equivalent of easy difficulty for the No More Heroes franchise. The run itself is pretty straightforward, with no major glitches and abusing mainly the most powerful tools in Travis' kit.
categories.name: any% NG+ Sweet

games.description: Travis Strikes Again is the spin-off entry of the No More Heroes saga, with a bird's view camera and focused on using special skills to destroy hoards of enemies. Travis Touchdown will enter the world of several videogames, where he'll have to defeat the final boss of each of them to get a wish granted.
games.name: Travis Strikes Again: No More Heroes

categories.description: The default way of running the game, don't let them tell you this category is slow at all! Any optimisation for this game has been poured into this category where timing, tiny windows of input and health management are of paramount importance.
categories.name: Any% Slow

games.description:
But we will try! In ‘No one can stop Mr. Domino!’ we take control of his namesake and carefully navigate 7 trap laden levels whilst building combos of domino trails. As a result, some crazy things happen. Car crashes, rockets being sent to space, growing vegetables and many other oddities will be on show.
(Part of the Happy Hours)
games.name: No One Can Stop Mr. Domino!

categories.description: First person tank controlled adventure? Yessirrrrr
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
This is a 20th century art instalment.
 Based on Naohisa Inoue's surrealist universe Iblard, we traverse a world with a design that compliments the PS1's hardware. Our main goal is to collect bus passes and crystals across a collection of maze-like levels to save Iblard (in turn birthing a new body of earth) and get home to our withering plants. Along the way we watch some mesmerising FMVs, befriend some dinosaurs, fight some UFOs and do a lil parkour."
(Part of the Happy Hours)
games.name: Iblard: Laputa no Kaeru Machi

categories.description: Any% is a precision platforming run. We navigate through all 5 visions, collecting emblems in every stage. A chill, glitchless run with little optimisations all over the place.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Folks know Klonoa, right? The stylish PS1 platformer with a cutesie protagonist… thing. Well not long after the success of the series’ first release, it took a dive where very few other series went, onto the Wonderswan! The result is a charming greyscale platformer with music that leaves a lot to be desired and the use of the extra face buttons of the Wonderswan when we change device rotation mid-run! (best of luck tech, ily)
games.name: Klonoa: Moonlight Museum

categories.description: Basic completion of the game includes collecting every disc and rebuilding every single track that we (a shoe) have spread across the world (which is actually in a synthesiser)
categories.name: All Discs

games.description:
Flying shoe makes music around earth (and alien abundant locations). Gaball Screen is an elaborate point and click that serves infinitely more than what you put into it in the most incredible ways. A hard one to describe, but is an experience everyone should have.
(Part of the Happy Hours)
games.name: Gaball Screen

categories.description: As opposed to the Great Ending, we only have to collect the minimum amount of Bits that can be found across the game.
categories.name: Good Ending

games.description:
Planet Dob is yet again another music infused PS1 game but even more outlandish than Gaball Screen. We are very much in the fictional world as we have to go about 8 different quadrants in this big ol' collectathon. Amongst our traversal of these quadrants, we'll enter a plethora of other game genres through mini games. Things like rhythm games, puzzle games, tunnel runners and shmups, this has a little bit of everything to leave you intrigued and jamming out. 
(Part of the Happy Hours)
games.name: Planet Dob

categories.description: This is the Any% Category, :)
categories.name: The Price is Right (ESA Style)

games.description: As last year, I'm offering the best interactive game for everyone at ESA to be part of, The Price is Right! Complete with fun, random games, and the incentive to be good, this game will provide onsite fun for those attending and playing!  I personally would love for a potential game to be on site at ESA, but not just one 1 day, but Thursday, Friday and Saturday during the event.  Think of it as a 3 Part Special! Games won will donate to the cause with the biggest event being on Saturday!!
games.name: The Price is Right (ESA Style)

categories.description: It's the Any% Run
categories.name: Any%

games.description: So it's all about Abobo, but unfortunately, his little one has been taken from him. Knowing how rage ridden he is, he is determined to get him back, whether he has to tackle levels from Mario, Double Dragon, Balloon Fight, Zelda or more. Join me as we tackle Abobo all throughout the lands of Mario and fight to get his son back from the evil... Mac? Yep. that's how it goes here!
games.name: Abobo's Big Adventure

categories.description: It's 6 games performed any% style.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: We go through 6 of the short yet amazing handheld Sonic's in a mini-marathon.  Sonic 1, 2, Chaos, Triple Trouble, Blast and the AMAZING Labyrinth. Sit back, relax and experience the Sonic Sextet!
games.name: The Sonic 6 (8-Bit Edition)

categories.description: It's the any% run of the game
categories.name: Any%

games.description: It's Mega Man from over 50 years ago.  That's right, its Mega Man Atari Demake.  This is what happens when you put a classic game like Mega Man 2 with the graphics, music and the LOVE of the Atari 2600.... You get THIS, the masterpiece.   Submitting this as any% because, well that's about the only category of this game, LOL
games.name: Mega Man 2 Atari Demake

categories.description: It's the Randomizer performed Any% style!
categories.name: Any% Randomizer

games.description: It's the Resident Evil 3 Randomizer, however, this is pure INSANITY as unlike previous years, we now as  we randomize the enemies, the items AND worst, I'm sorry, best of all, the doors! This is a stepup from last year with a little more challenge involved and probably some note taking! HAHA. Combined with randomizes NPC DIalogue from 16 RE Games, this should be a great watch and run!
games.name: Resident Evil 3 Randomizer

categories.description: Complete all 14 levels as quick as possible. This run will be the Master System version of the game.
categories.name: Any% SMS

games.description: This classic game from 1986 is a hidden gem on the Sega Library. Alex Kidd was the original Sega Mascot pre-dating Sonic the Hedgehog. The Lost Stars is the second game in the series. While the game may look like a meme with the colourful cutesy graphics and digitized voice audio, the run offers a lot of precise jumping, shooting and quick thinking to avoid RNG. However, the main amusement is when Alex takes damage and let's out an over the top scream which always gets people laughing. Ahhhh!
games.name: Alex Kidd The Lost Stars

categories.description: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1989044379?t=0h0m2s
categories.name: Darker side

games.description: Super Mario Odyssey is game released in 2017 where the goal of the game is to collect the set amount of moons you need to gather in every kingdom and save peach from Bowser in the moon kingdom. With very cool movement and new glitches, speedruns of this game has evolved a lot over the years. There are still a lot in this game that has not yet been seen at the ESA marathon with the last Any% showcase being in 2020, and some categories not yet being seen.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: All moons is a category where collect every moon in every kingdom with the exception of the duplicate shopping moons you unlock after completing the moon kingdom. This also includes beating the special bowser re fight you unlock after getting every moon.
categories.name: All moons

games.description: Super Mario Odyssey is game released in 2017 where the goal of the game is to collect the set amount of moons you need to gather in every kingdom and save peach from Bowser in the moon kingdom. With very cool movement and new glitches, speedruns of this game has evolved a lot over the years. There are still a lot in this game that has not yet been seen at the ESA marathon with the last Any% showcase being in 2020, and some categories not yet being seen.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: For the main Any% route we need to get both 100 of the game's main collectible "Eggs" across the whole of it to open the final boss door at the end of the game. This is accomplished through awesome movement, gem collection, out of bounds sections, item storages, and many other rad tricks!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: For the current run of Year of The Dragon any% we do not have access to a sorceress skip, meaning that we have to meet the 100 egg requirement to open the door to the final boss in hub 4. Each level has loads of tricks to advance through to grab eggs as well as maintain a steady gem count. Over the years since its initial inception the route has gone through more changes which has subsequently increased the difficulty of the run while raising the ceiling for top level runs to improve at.
games.name: Spyro Reignited Trilogy: Year of The Dragon

categories.description: This category involves quite a bit of collection with my specific route needing to acquire 800 gems as well as the main necessity being to get to the end of each level to collect its Talisman (14 in total) as fast as possible while taking on the occasional boss here and there before fighting Ripto!
categories.name: 14 Talisman

games.description: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage is the sequel to the original Spyro The Dragon, in this new adventure Spyro takes on the likes on Ripto to take back the world of Avalar from his clutches. This specific speedrun of Spyro 2 involves us doing exactly what Elora told us at the start of the game and that is collecting the 14 Talismans as well as orbs in the Summer Forest and Autumn Plains home worlds. We then make it into the third and final home world Winter Tundra to confront Ripto using some fun tricks!
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: The fastest completion of the game without the use of checkpoint skips.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Originally released in 2010 by Rockstar Games, Red Dead Redemption is a Western-themed classic set during the decline of the American frontier in 1911. It follows John Marston, a former outlaw who sets out to bring his former gang members to justice. The game shares some similarities with Grand Theft Auto, such as movement mechanics, physics, mission design and more! The run will be focused on movement and time management with the story missions, as well as some good old Western shooting.
games.name: Red Dead Redemption

categories.description: The fastest completion of the game.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Undead Nightmare is a non-canonical DLC pack that mixes the classic Western-themed setting with zombies, creating one of the most critically acclaimed expansion packs ever made. John Marston must once again pick up his guns to find the cure of the virus that has plagued the land. The speedrun is considered by some as the best in the series due to it's fast-paced gameplay, short length, and high intensity of movement and shooting, compared to the more relaxed pace of the base game.
games.name: Red Dead Redemption: Undead Nightmare

categories.description: Any% is basically collecting the "final" star of the mod, Comet Observatory 2. To unlock this galaxy, you need to collect 12 star to open the 2nd final galaxy and collect every Stamps from every galaxy, including the 2nd final galaxy.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Neo Mario Galaxy is a Super Mario Galaxy 2 Romhack made by Aurum. It's one of the 1st Mario Galaxy mod ever made, all the way back in 2017, but through the years it received 2 major updates.  It shows many cool feature and ability that community made just for this game! This include... Stamps?
games.name: Neo Mario Galaxy

categories.description: We'll finish the first two years, to the final boss fight with Slymmer, where we'll end the run by defeating him. (And turning him into a frog for some reason?)
categories.name: Defeat Slymmer%

games.description: An old Myst-like / farming sim made as an advertisement game for Arla back in 1997 - for Windows 3.1
games.name: Myulk

categories.description: Any% is a very fun and fast category, featuring the whole main story of the game without spending too much time backtracking for quests. The run has a great deal of luck involved, thanks to randomised warp rooms and some farming for items; this keeps the run feeling fresh every time you do it.
categories.name: Any% (60fps)

games.description: Yohane the Parhelion -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-, released November 2023, is a game that nobody saw coming: a Metroidvania, based on a spin-off of the Love Live! anime series. Although the game is fairly new, the route is well-established and makes smart use of what the underwater dungeon offers us. The game takes us through 21 boss fights in just under an hour, featuring very quick and flashy kills, while we rescue eight partners to use throughout the game.
games.name: Yohane the Parhelion -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-

categories.description: Any% takes us through all of the normal (non-secret) levels in the Shake Dimension, eventually leading us to the Shake King's hideout. The money route makes this game stand out: we are required to collect 501,000 coins in total, to buy all of the area maps. The flashy boss kills are a big highlight!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Wario Land: Shake It! (also known as The Shake Dimension in PAL regions) is the most recent entry in the dormant Wario Land series, released for the Wii in 2008. Despite being nearly 16 years old, the game holds up very well to this day, with beautiful hand-drawn graphics, and the coolest and most macho incarnation of Wario to date. Being on the Wii, the game requires the use of motion and especially tilt controls, which need to be mastered for the speedrun.
games.name: Wario Land: Shake It!

categories.description: This category starts from a fresh file but with one special difference from normal any%. We can use assist features and these are invincibility, no fall damage, and narrative combat which is dealing double damage. This makes the run way more about the tech and tricks over more boring combat.
categories.name: Any% w/Assist

games.description: Psychonauts 2 is about a young boy with supernatural abilities named Raz who is an intern for a secret spy organization called the psychonauts. The game follows a mystery of an individual trying to infiltrate the organization. The game features one huge glitch allowing you to fly on objects in the world completing entire levels very quickly and skipping large sections. There are also many movement glitches to propel Raz forward. Since we are using assist features combat is also very quick.
games.name: Psychonauts 2

categories.description: This run is on a new game plus save which means the game has already been completed and we have all weapons at max level. We also are able to use some of the skill point challenge extras. This makes combat very fast and almost non existent focusing on the tricks and out of bounds areas.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: This game is the predecessor to Rift Apart which is the newest Ratchet game. This game follows a side adventure where Ratchet must stop a criminal who has escaped prison named Vendra. Her goal is to steal the Dimensinator, a dangerous device able to open portals to other dimensions. This is a very short run and features only 6 levels. This game does not have much movement glitches but tons of out of bounds and clipping through walls making it a marvel to watch.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Into The Nexus

categories.description: Pilot Spoiler is a showcase of a different way to race the randomizer, in which the runner (Jem) gets steered by a pilot with a spoiler log (clearmouse). The pilot does not have access to the log until the run starts, so the route needs to be figured out together on the fly. Co-comm is Eriror.
categories.name: Pilot Spoiler Keysanity

games.description: The randomizer for Zelda: ALttP puts a spin on the classic SNES title, in which all the items are shuffled while ensuring the game is completable. The keysanity variation includes shuffling dungeon items and keys, in addition to the traditional prizes (bow, hammer) and consumables (rupees, heart pieces), requiring more items to be found in order to complete the seed. The goal is to obtain 7 crystals by beating their respective dungeons, climbing Ganon's Tower and beating Ganon.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past Randomizer

categories.description: The category is the same as the traditional NMG Any% No S&Q category, but with the allowed ruleset and features of the randomizer. This means that some strats are now allowed, like icebreaker in Ice Palace, thereby speeding up the route. Commentators are clearmouse and Eriror.
categories.name: Any% No S&Q NMG (Rando Ruleset)

games.description: Instead of randomly shuffling the items, the vanilla preset mode of A Link to the Past randomizer keeps all the items in the same locations as the base game. This speedrun allows us to take advantage of some of the randomizer's features, such as no text boxes, quick swapping items without the menu screen, as well as player experience upgrades, such as using custom sprites and MSU (music). Other features include fixed 0 Agahnim blue balls, 0 Ganon warps, fixed boss RNG and reduced lag.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past Randomizer Vanilla Preset

categories.description: This is a modded category, that removes all the waiitng times making a 6 hour long run. beatable in 40 minutes.
categories.name: Timeskip Ending A

games.description: Dead Risings is a zombie survival game. With the goal of exploring the willamette mall agiest a 72 hour timer before you escape (6 hours IRL) within these 6 hours you play as Frank West a photojournalist (who has covered wars you know.) during this time you can save survivors, kill psychopaths and zombies or try and unlock the differant secret items within the game tied to achievements.
games.name: Dead Rising

categories.description: Complete the game while killing all the bosses. This catagory shows the infamous PNG/JPEG cutscene.
categories.name: All bosses

games.description: Rise of Kong was dubed one of the worst games released in 2023. The game follows the story Kong who's goal is to go through puberty to kill the monster that killed his monther.
games.name: Skull Island: Rise of Kong

categories.name: Level 10 Gardener

games.description: Viva piñata is a simple gardening/farming simulation. with the goal of managing you're garden to attarct new piñatas. The overall end goal of the game is to complete the journal
games.name: Viva Piñata

categories.description: Beat the game using glitches and OOB tricks to beat the final boss.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Rise of Kong was dubed one of the worst games released in 2023. The game follows the story Kong who's goal is to go through puberty to kill the monster that killed his monther.
games.name: Skull Island: Rise of Kong

categories.description: Fasterground is a mod created by Jigsaw, which leaves only 1 URL race type needed per Stage, which shortens the run by 2 hours, no any other changes are made in this mod. The goal is to complete Career as fast as possible, while using glitches. (This is my second best game with 600+ hours streamed).
categories.name: Fasterground 2 Any%

games.description: Need for Speed: Underground 2 is a 2004 racing video game developed by EA Black Box and published by Electronic Arts. It is the eighth installment in the Need for Speed series and the direct sequel to Need for Speed: Underground. The game takes place in the city of Bayview after coming from Olympic City. The main character is trying to climb the ladder in the city's street racing scene, while having a lot of customizable options.
games.name: Need for Speed: Underground 2

categories.description: The goal of the game is to complete the Cop story part of the game as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any% Cop

games.description: Hot Pursuit lets players be either a racer or a police driver, and features a full career mode for both roles. The relationship between the cops and racers is described as "a dog chasing down a rabbit"; the police being more powerful while the racers are faster.
games.name: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit Remastered

categories.description: The goal of the category is to complete the career as fast as possible while using all glitches. (This is my main speedrun game, I have over 2000 streamed hours of this game).
categories.name: Career Any% Glitches

games.description: Need for Speed: Most Wanted is a 2005 racing video game, and the ninth installment in the Need for Speed series. Developed by EA Canada and EA Black Box and published by Electronic Arts. The story takes place in Rockport City, the main character loses his BMW and the goal of the game is to climb up the Blacklist by winning races and earning bounty from cop chases and  eventually get his car back. While he is doing this he is constantly being the target of the main cop in the city Cross.
games.name: Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)

categories.description: The goal of the category is to complete the main story as fast as possible while using glitches and No DLCs are allowed.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Need for Speed Heat is an adrenaline-fueled, vibrant racing game where the lines of the law fade as the sun starts to set. The game takes place in the vibrant city of Palm City. The main character are trying to make a name for themselves while forming a crew with another street racer, eventually realizing the cops in the city are corrupted and taking them down.
games.name: Need for Speed: Heat

categories.description: The goal of the speedrun is to complete the main story as fast as possible while being allowed to use glitches, but no DLCs are allowed.
categories.name: Story Any% Base Glitchless

games.description: Need for Speed Unbound is a racing game set in a fictional city called Lakeshore City, which is based on Chicago. It features an open world environment and gameplay similar to that of previous entries in the series, being mainly focused around street racing with more animated graphics.
games.name: Need for Speed: Unbound

categories.description: Standard Any% run to beat the story as quickly as possible. We use a lot of Out of Bounds to skip large sections, if not entire levels and the game has a seriously high DPI setting to use a tech with the mouse to change targets incredibly quickly when shooting.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: We play as Marcus, an NYPD Police Officer who witnesses the death of his mentor. When he learns his death may be linked to several crime gangs, he sets out to discover the truth, whilst not entirely being mindful about upholding the law.
games.name: True Crime: New York City

categories.description: We take optimal paths to avoid enemies and use certain combination of spells to clear them out when needed. There are also a few Out of Bound tricks in the game to skip certain levels and very long cutscenes. We also deliberately crash the game and reload in order to skip past cutscenes.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Take Call of Duty, add wands and this is what you get. A shooter style game progressing through areas of the movie taking out death eaters, dementors and some boss battles along the way.
games.name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 1

categories.description: We use strats to manipulate the camera in order to split up to save time and we collect the most optimal shields to progress the game. As a disclaimer, I have run this game a lot, whilst my co-op partner is just learning the co-op run but rest assured it can still be a solid run and entertaining.
categories.name: Any% 2 Players

games.description: HP4 took the exploration from the previous games and completely scrapped it, instead opting for an action style level based game in various areas of Hogwarts and the 3 Triwizard Tasks.
games.name: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

categories.description: No Out of Bounds allowed so we must fight every manadatory fight in the game which actually makes this more marathon friendly as we unlock the better attacks much sooner and we gain higher levelled heroes meaning there is a much lower chance of dying.
categories.name: Full Game Any% Glitchless

games.description: A turn based RPG, set during the story of The Lord of the Rings. We follow a group tracking the fellowship and we take part in events from the films such as defending Helms Deep, the siege of Osgiliath and the defence of Minas Tirith. We have 6 characters to use who we gather throughout the game, all of which have unique skill trees to unlock really powerful attacks. One character at one stage unlocks the ability to deal thousands of points of damage to all enemies in a single turn.
games.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Third Age

categories.description: We play through the game as fast as possible by fighting as optimally as we can.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This game is based on the manga/anime series Demon Slayer. The game plays until the end of the 2nd Arc and is a battle based game.
games.name: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles

categories.description: Normally we skip certain parts of the game by playing a match of Quidditch but in this we play them and find other ways through the levels because that trick is forbidden.
categories.name: Warpless

games.description: A neat Adventure Jump and Run game that is based on the Harry Potter Franchise and therefore a lot of people played it in their childhood. Its also a very broken game and we will make Harry fly up in the air, walk on invisible walls, teleport and more.
games.name: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

categories.description: Any% used to take about 25 min longer until not too long ago because the games gives you a list of tasks you need to complete before it lets you leave. Well thankfully there is a way to skip that now! On top of that we aquire magic to swing like Tarzan, cast through walls and Lagjump around...
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A neat Adventure Jump and Run game that is based on the Harry Potter Franchise and therefore a lot of people played it in their childhood. Its a bit more polished compared to its predecessors but they still didnt manage to make it "Speedrun Proof" so there are more than a couple exploits...
games.name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (PC)

categories.description: This category lets us skip all the cutscenes and have all the spells at the beginning which makes it significantly faster than any% and also a lot more enjoyable to play and watch, There's no glitches but there are cutscene skips and a lot of small optimizations throughout the entire run.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: In the last game of the Harry Potter series you have to find the horcruxes that are left to defeat Voldemort. They are hidden at different places which we are going to visit, those are places you saw or heard about in the movies/books. You have to fight death eaters at different locations and survive the attacks. It's a shooter based game with a very nice level design.
games.name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2

categories.description: This category the runner must defeat Bowser (Any%) while also collecting all 240 blue coins in the game. This adds an interesting routing element not seen in Any% or 120 Shines. Runners are constantly moving between blues and there are very few slow shines that you might see in 120.
categories.name: All Blue Coins

games.description:
Super Mario Sunshine is a classic 3D platformer, combining Mario's typical movement tools with the game's unique FLUDD and water mechanics. These mechanics add an insane amount of depth to the movement, and many of the techniques will really wow all the people who played this game growing up.

The game has a very active player base, and there have been many optimizations in the past few years across all the major categories making this an exciting marathon run.
games.name: Super Mario Sunshine

categories.description: 120 Shines is the 100% category, where runners collect 96 physical shines and 240 blue coins. The addition of the blue coins makes this category very fast paced, as well as an interesting routing challenge. There are also many unique strategies using the rocket and turbo nozzles not seen in Any%.
categories.name: 120 Shines

games.description:
Super Mario Sunshine is a classic 3D platformer, combining Mario's typical movement tools with the game's unique FLUDD and water mechanics. These mechanics add an insane amount of depth to the movement, and many of the techniques will really wow all the people who played this game growing up.

The game has a very active player base, and there have been many optimizations in the past few years across all the major categories making this an exciting marathon run.
games.name: Super Mario Sunshine

categories.description: This category does not abuse of any glitches, like the Wall Climb glitch, Damage Duplication glitch or any OOB skips. That way, it's the lengthiest showcase of the game, spanning every area and boss fight required to complete it. The EASY difficulty removes any necessity of grinding.
categories.name: No Skips (Easy)

games.description: A free metroidvania megaten game, prequel to Shin Megami Tensei: Strange Journey, focused on Jack Frost and Pyro Jack's journey to defeat Black Frost. This game was created just to promote Strange Journey and therefore is quite short, but it became a fan favourite for its simple but fast-paced combat and engaging movement.
games.name: Shin Megami Tensei: Synchronicity Prologue

categories.description: As the name suggests, we defeat All Bosses in the game without the use of skips or glitches. It showcases many fights and dungeons that are usually skipped in the Glitchless and Any% category.
categories.name: All Bosses

games.description: The first Shin Megami Tensei game is a well routed, challenging run that showcases familiar demons and difficult boss fights that are dealt with through the easily exploitable battle mechanics. Shorter than most other SMT games, the speedrun offers an insight into this hidden gem that was never localized and showcases what would become the series' identifiable features whilst already having the high risk high reward feel that it has come to be known for.
games.name: Shin Megami Tensei

categories.description: We beat the game as fast as possible, utilizing any known skips.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Atlus' response to the rising popularity of Pokemon in the early 2000s, DemiKids is a cutesy version of megaten aimed at promoting the franchise to children that still keeps the main features of the series, such as demon negotiations, with a surprisingly tragic story. It is exactly what the parent's thought Pokemon was in the 90s.
games.name: DemiKids: Dark Version

categories.description: This category completes the game without any of the NG+ bonuses.
categories.name: NG Ending

games.description: 90s era first person dungeon crawler oozing charm and drowning in RNG madness. Compared to other SMT runs, this run has no frustrating recruitment RNG or deaths to random encounters due to the (legal) difficulty hacks. On the other hand, there's like 2 boss fights that are so RNG heavy they can make the devil pray to god for forgiveness. But the dungeons and movement is some of the most satisfying in the entire franchise, which makes for a very entertaining run to watch.
games.name: Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers

categories.description: Unlike a lot of other Any% categories, this one sees the majority of the levels, resulting in a world record just under 90 minutes long. While the first four worlds are not too challenging, the difficulty really ramps up after that, requiring constant focus and nerve control towards the end.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Released in 2010 for the Wii, Donkey Kong Country Returns is Retro Studios' take on the original DKC trilogy. It features eight main worlds, lots of motion controls and of course an in-built speedrunning mode, Time Attack. While not the most beginner-friendly speedgame, it's certainly an underrated one, focusing on tricky execution and consistency as opposed to major glitches or tiny optimisations. Commentary provided by LeahKazuno.
games.name: Donkey Kong Country Returns

categories.description: This category involves beating every stage of the game and thereby achieving what the game deems "100%" on a save file, requiring all KONG letters to be collected to unlock certain levels. Luckily there's no need to worry about Puzzle Pieces, Time Attack medals or Mirror Mode though.

games.description: Released in 2010 for the Wii, Donkey Kong Country Returns is Retro Studios' take on the original DKC trilogy. It features eight main worlds, lots of motion controls and of course an in-built speedrunning mode, Time Attack. While not the most beginner-friendly speedgame, it's certainly an underrated one, focusing on tricky execution and consistency as opposed to major glitches or tiny optimisations. Commentary provided by LeahKazuno.
games.name: Donkey Kong Country Returns

categories.description: Complete the 45 levels of the game.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Electronic Super Joy is a pretty hard platformer and one of the first really important Indie Games. It was released in 2013 (11 years ago :o). This game has some auto scrollers where you can increase speed and some bosses manipulation (including the chapter 2 boss). The music is awesome too!
games.name: Electronic Super Joy

categories.description: Complete the game in the hardest difficulty mode.
categories.name: Arcade Very Hard

games.description: Beach Spikers is a beach volley game released in 2002 on Nintendo Gamecube, it was adapted from an arcade game. Even though it sounds like a meme game, it is not. There are strategies to go fast. WR (by me) was done 8 years ago and was super optimize.
games.name: Beach Spikers

categories.description: Complete all 4 cups of the game. Which is 12 races.
categories.name: All Cups

games.description: Wild Animal Racing is an exciting go-kart simulation game with a twist. Play as one of the wild animals and be the fastest animal on this planet. This game is AWESOME and need some love. Mandatoory if you have a meme block :)
games.name: Wild Animal Racing

categories.description: Complete the game as fast as possible, we're using a lot of glitches as shown in the video, this way, we break the game!
categories.name: Any% Unrestricted 1.1.1+

games.description: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling is an action RPG really similar to Paper Mario. It was released on 2019 on computer. Vi, Kabbu and Leif are going to a journey to uncover the deepest secrets of Bugaria. There are some turn based fight and 3D platforming in the whole game with some upgrade mechanics.
games.name: Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling

categories.description: Linkboss and me goes fast through France avoiding the police CoolFace
categories.name: 2P1C

games.description: Paris Marseille Racing (or PMR, or best racing game ever) is a game released in 2000 by Davilex Games. During this game, you have to go through Paris to French Riviera (and not Marseille lol) by a serie of 5 races. This game is terrible, but the speedrun is pretty cool, especially for memes.
games.name: Paris Marseille Racing

categories.description: This Any% speedrun starts when you load the file and ends on the final hit on the final boss, No restrictions!
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
This Playstation 2 3D platformer is a timeless classic loved by many, and is the greatest speedrun I have ever seen with some of the most unique movement tech and huge skips! It's a perfect game to demonstrate to a major speedrun event. This game has a plethora of history which would make the commentary interesting, humorous and enlightening.

(This is my main submission game)
games.name: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus

categories.description: This Any% speedrun starts when you select dad and ends on the final cutscene, No restrictions!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Bluey the video game is a fun family-friendly platformer story game. Sit back, relax and be entertained by the run, couch and red balloons! This show is loved all around the world and the skips are very entertaining
games.name: Bluey: The Videogame

categories.description: The highlight of this run is the use of various tools to do anything from crossing small gaps on exploding frogs,  or gaining insane speed and height with energy balls, to literally deleting parts of levels.  A run that is easy to follow and has recently become both faster and more consistent.
categories.name: Any% No Level Skips Co-Op

games.description: BattleBlock Theater is a comedic 2D platformer where you are stranded on an island with little but a theater run by cats. Make your way, alone or with a friend, through a bunch of levels and collect gems in order to save your best friend Hatty Hattington and escape this horrible place.
games.name: Battleblock Theater

categories.description: Heinki fights his way through random missions in Starcraft 2. SeductiveSpatula travels through time and dimensions in A Link to the Past or Timespinner, Cadarev explores secrets in the world of TUNIC, searching for a stick, while RandomPinkBunny unlocks hints for them through the power of Sudoku
categories.name: Multiworld Coop

games.description: Archipelago is a framework allowing multiworld randomization across a, constantly growing, number of different games. This means that players will not only be playing a randomized version of their preferred game and finding items for it, but items from every participating player will be shuffled across all the games in question. Want a sword in Ocarina of Time? It might be found in Rainbow Ride in Super Mario 64. Looking for the ice beam in Super Metroid? It could be an achievement in Minecraft.
games.name: Archipelago Multiworld

categories.description: Finish the game by completing 15 chapters. Now featuring the flying skips! Because every mafia knows that flying is the fastest way of transport.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A 2nd game in the mafia series, this time featuring new main character Vito Scaletta. After coming back from war, his best friend (and the funniest guy ever) Joe meets him and with his help he joins the dark underground of criminal life and mafia. In hopes to pay off his mother depts he goes to prison, and loses much what he cherishes the most.
games.name: Mafia II

categories.description: Finishing the story by completing 4 chapters + finale. We do some of the substories as it's required by the story progression.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A latest action packed game from rgg studio, the studio behind the legendary yakuza series (now like a dragon). This game is situated between the events of yakuza 6 and 7 (yakuza: like a dragon in west), featuring a familiar face with familiar voice Joryu? Oh right it's Kiryu. This game is supposed to be shorter then your regular mainline game, but with one of the most refined Kiryu combat, featuring a fast way to get rid of groups of enemies (yes we abuse that a lot). Smoking kills
games.name: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name

categories.description: Finishing the main objectives/story + all the side missions including some funky ones like fake ryuji gang or collecting bunch of golden... balls? Also including all Coliseum matches with Hell Team Rumble... and Hell Team Rumble is scary
categories.name: All Substories
