categories.description: This category includes both stories (Kotaro and Lin), both of the stories performed by different runners. This way we finish the game on true ending which includes one extra boss.
categories.name: Any% True Ending

games.description: A game from 1999 also known as Ronin Blade in Europe, trying to copy the old school resident evil style, but in Japan, and there are bunch of samurais and ninjas. Other than that the game tries to be a hack and slash in it's core, with different combos that can be executed through a different combination of buttons. The game got released originally on Playstation 1, but we gonna be running on ps2 with fast disc speed.
games.name: Soul of the Samurai

categories.description: Beat the main game on the hardest difficulty.
categories.name: Hard

games.description:
Officially known as Koumajou Densetsu II or Koumajou Remilia II, this Touhou fangame based upon the Castlevania series does not involve a single bit of randomness and is purely based on execution.
Movement is what makes this speedrun shine especially thanks to its backdash mechanic making for a pleasing show to the viewers.
Bossfights at the end of each stages go by just as fast thanks to strong subweapons available to the player when progressing to the next stage.
games.name: Touhouvania 2

categories.description: Goal is to fight every character in the game and have them join our party as a result. This will be done on version 1.00 of the game which allows the player to do the the Super Jump trick making certain areas explorable earlier than they're supposed to be.
categories.name: All Characters (Normal - 1.00)

games.description:
Touhou fangame based upon a NES game called "Atlantis no Nazo" where mysterious doors have appeared all around Gensokyo.
Having a fair share of platforming and boss fights, each character's unique ability in terms of damage output and movement speed is what makes this run really shine as we get to see a highly varied run when it comes to gameplay. Moreover, this game has very little randomness. Pure Skill only.
games.name: Gensokyo no Nazo

categories.description: Complete the game as fast as possible. Run starts when pressing the "play" button and ends upon entering the final portal in level 10.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Battle for Hogwarts is one of the most competitive, breathtaking and fulfilling games ever created. The games popularity skyrocketed during ESA Winter 2024 when Oggyerino taught fellow attendees how to speedrun the game. 

The game itself is a simple flash based game where the objective is to stop Voldemort in his tracks by collecting all horcruxes. The game has 10 levels and a huge amount of tricks and strats.

(This game is part of thaRixer's flash block, do not accept if the block gets in)
games.name: LEGO Harry Potter: The Battle for Hogwarts

categories.description: Complete the game as fast as possible. Run starts when pressing the "play" button and ends upon entering the final portal in level 10. This category can be played with 2 or 3 people, each utilizing one of the three inputs.
categories.name: Co-op Any%

categories.description: Complete the game as fast as possible. Run starts when pressing the "start" button after selecting language and ends upon passing through a load zone after chasing the villains.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Noddy is a childrens character that has touched the hearts of many. The Noddy series features books, tv shows, toys and games, and it is prime time to show off this classic on the big screen. Noddy and the Magic Book is a game revolving around a story of theft, friendship and action packed gameplay. You play as Noddy who is sort of the "can-do-anything-guy" in Toyland. The game is not glitch heavy and rather focuses on various mini games. Finish the tasks and help the police catch the bad guys!
games.name: Noddy and the Magic Book

categories.description: So this is the easiest mode of the game. That allows you to "manipulate" the rng pattern of the opponents in more easier way than the harder difficulties. Due to, you being able to knock down in the center of the boxing ring more easily that or in the ring corner so you face them straight up.
categories.name: Novice (Movie Mode)

games.description:
This game has a lot of different RNG patterns, depending on how the opponent moves and acts.  It is a bit challenging to get the perfect run, but there is various possiblities to "change" the RNG, based on how you knock your opponent.  A lot of the game, comes down to punching in the stomach so it gets a bit repetitive but, due to being able to speedrun this game, you can always have fun and change things up.

This is the Rocky game about the Rocky Movies from 1 to 5.
games.name: Rocky (2002)

categories.description: Any%, so you are allowed to go Out of Bounds, do ladder glitches and other allowed glitches in the game to beat the game as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
I mean, it is TMNT for the NES, one of the harder games for the NES to speedrun due to the spike of difficulties. The very infamous DAM level when you swim to defuse bombs but also try not to die to electric seaweed and electricity and a timer that is running out. The OoB glitches and also trying to find Technodrome in Hole 1, that RNG pattern. 

I got to run this during ESA Summer 2022, but, the run was not perfect and I was ill during it, I hope to be able to revenge myself and this game.
games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

categories.description: As per usual, the goal is to beat the game without any restrictions on skips/glitches. This category uses the HRH mod, which allows the player to have access to Hill Runner's Hat in every run, making the run faster and allowing for more skips. HRH can be boring to grind and the mod helps with that.
categories.name: Any% (HRH Mod)

games.description: Last seen at ESA a few years ago, BioShock Infinite Any% is probably one of the most active categories in the series, and for a while now, features great skips that involve high FPS and many, many deathwarps . Adding to that, the run makes use of 2 different gear items that completely change the movement in the game, making it ultra fast. Other than skips, the game is filled with many fights that have been  fully optimized and others that are completely skipped.
games.name: BioShock Infinite

categories.description: God of War 3 doesn't have a NG+ option, but glitchhunters made sure it did, Through some trickery at the start of the run, the runner can have access to every weapon and ability from the start. The PS3 category showcases more areas and skips, making the run way more interesting to watch.
categories.name: Any% NG+

games.description: God of War 3 is an amazing experience both visually and glitch-wise. It is filled with skips everywhere, some of them semi-blind, having Kratos "fly" while the camera is fixed at a certain point in the screen, which can look confusing but also satisfying when the runner hits the skips.
games.name: God of War 3

categories.description: In 2022, Xem and I raced this category at a point where the run was extremely difficult in a no reset/marathon scenario. Since then the category has become way faster and easier making a rematch much more likely to be closer than it was before. The crowd always shows up for ratchet, especially races
categories.name: All Gold Bolts

games.description: In the last two years there have been two rac1 races at ESA summer. In 2022 between xem and myself, and in 2023 an ng+ race between Marathonman and Jishkared. The crowd always shows up to support the playstation folk, especially for race showcases.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank

categories.description: A relay run featuring Isaki, Myself and Xem allow us to showcase all these games have to offer. All 3 games entertaining in ther own right.  All 3 of us at the top of our game and very close to WR could produce one of the most entertaining showcases of the event.
categories.name: All Special Bolts

games.description: The original 3 ratchet & clank games. All 3 have their similarities but a trilogy run would allow all their unique skillsets to be showcased.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank Trilogy

categories.description: A relay run featuring saphy, myself, xem and muckemannen. All four of us are WR holders or at least contenders in each category. A showcase of all four games in one would allow us to show the best of what these games have to offer, with NG+ showcasing primarily how we can get from A-B the fastest
categories.name: NG+

games.description: The original four ratchet & clank games. All four have been showcased at ESA in recent years with the exception being rac3, the game that has changed almost entirely since it's last showcase specifically at an ESA.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank Quadfecta

categories.description: Ratchet 2's best category has not been featured at ESA in a few years. Since then the category has had massive developments. My No IMG run in 2022 was awesome because of the crowd that showed up. A chance to have that again for over an hour would be surreal for myself and the crowd alike
categories.name: All Platinum Bolts

games.description: Ratchet & Clank 2 has had its' showcases over the years but never of it's longer and best category, which showcases all the game has to offer. Ratchet 2 is known for its tight movement that both feels good to execute and looks fun to do.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando

categories.description:
in Any% we utilize a skip called "Jesus Walk" to quickly make our way to the final boss and beat the game. The run is very simple with only a few things to learn which makes it very easy to teach to an audience, even while making jokes along the way. 

OBS. This run is presented by 2 people.
categories.name: Any% Tutorial

games.description: Sonic Suggests is a short game-jam project that was made as a joke. For this showcase we want to do a live tutorial for the Any% category while making it as entertaining as possible. DreeGon and I will dress up in black suits, plan witty commentary and talk in a very serious manner despite the game not being serious at all, all while still teaching the crowd the game. We believe this showcase could benefit ESA in many ways and would love to put on a good show!
games.name: Sonic Suggests

categories.description: In Amy's Story you play through the game as amy, while trying to beat the game as fast as possible. like the other stories Amy story got its own unique strats and gameplay mechanics to make up a super exciting  run.
categories.name: Am'y Story

games.description: Sonic Adventure DX is a game released in 2003. we'll be following Amy throughout her adventure of fighting Eggman, while she jumps and hammerflips her way through the different stages with alot of precise cool looking strats and skips.
games.name: Sonic Adventure DX (SADX)

categories.description: Glitchless is the toughest category of sotn main leaderboards because it requires for runner to have good knowledge of the game and be as efficient in mana usage as possible because it's the main resource in this run
categories.name: Glitchless any%

categories.name: Any%

games.description: Nirvana is a cool little game that was released as an end of year project by a small team of devs. It's a physics-based puzzle platformer that may remind you in small ways of QUBE and Portal: a testing environment, a gun that allows you to defy the laws of physics, and a dramatic story.
games.name: Nirvana: The First Travel

categories.description: All Secrets means I will not do the absolute fastest method of running this game that would make the run last a little less than 5 minutes. Seeded is a funny way to say I will start with a predetermined loadout. This will allow me to glitch through the game even faster.
categories.name: All Secrets Seeded

games.description: Onyx Clad is a fast-pace first person shooter where you play as a robot in a world where humanity seems to have been extinguished. The game runs extremely fast especially with the help of gadgets you can find around the levels that allow you to change your gameplay as you need it. In terms of speedrunning, Onyx Clad is also a very broken game if we have the right loadout, and routing is a big part of it.
games.name: Onyx Clad

categories.description: Good endings Mission Replay might sound like a weird category name, but it can be abbreviated as: Good Ending NG+. Additionally, this run will be done glitched, and as such we will abuse a bunch of small exploits to blitz through the game at breath-taking speeds.
categories.name: "Good" ending Missions Replay

games.description: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a new indie game that can be seen as a great homage to the stealth game genre as a whole. With plays on both shadows and lights, it reminds us of Aragami, but also of Splinter Cell and Dishonored. Follow the path of Ayana, the last of the Ereban, people who can merge within the shadows, as she tries to uncover the truth about her past, and where her fate lies.
games.name: Ereban; Shadow Legacy

categories.description: Any% is simply finishing this game as fast as possible. We use a bunch of clips to pass through walls and finish levels faster, though almost nothing gets fundamentally sequence-broken. A good experience of the game while mostly not spoiling the puzzle solutions as we do almost none the right way.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Epitasis is a small indie puzzle game released in 2019 that talks about a scientist that found their way on an alien world. The game is incredibly chill, featuring exactly one type of enemy you cannot fight and no NPCs. It's just good puzzling, chill tunes and atmospheric vibes.
games.name: Epitasis

categories.description:
The new Buster MAX Mode from the legacy collection multiples the damage from MegaMan's Buster times 100 and Single Segment means we can not reset the game to manipulate the RNG.
One Playthrough with tons of damage.
categories.name: Single Segment  Buster MAX On

games.description: Mega Man Battle Network is a spin-off of the Mega Man series. It's a tactical RPG where our heroes, Lan Hikari and MegaMan.EXE, save the internet from an evil net-crime organization headed by Dr. Wily. The game heavily relies on RNG, as we roam the internet to collect Battle Chips and engage in as few battles as possible. Quick thinking and the roll with the RNG-Dice makes the gameplay experience very enjoyable.
games.name: Mega Man Battle Network

categories.description: No LTS is a legacy category of Any%, where we collect 74 out of the total 101 power cells. Co-op with TeamRuns adds a fun extra layer to it. With the "Same level" variant, you'll see us in eachother's feed and working together a lot as opposed to going around cleaning up different levels.
categories.name: Co-op No LTS (Same Level)

games.description: Jak & Daxter is a 3D platformer for the PS2, which has had several successful marathon runs in the past. A team of dedicated programmers and fans of the series have created a full PC port of the game, called OpenGOAL, which has added support for mods. One of the most impressive mods is TeamRuns,  a multiplayer mod created by Dexz, who would be joining for commentary. This would be the first showcase of OpenGOAL and TeamRuns at an ESA, a major milestone for the projects and the community.
games.name: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (TeamRuns)

categories.description: The main ending of the game, in New Game+. A very fun category because one of the best moves in the game, the death disk (aka DD), sacrifices life for the benefit of damage. Your HP then becomes a resource in its own right.
categories.name: NG+ Judas Ending

games.description: ICEY is a Chinese indie game. It's a 2D beat'em all in a futuristic environment. It's a very nervous speedrun, with two skips and above all an optimization of the fights which becomes central to obtaining a good time.
games.name: ICEY

categories.description: This category prohibits the use of RNG Manipulation, making it impossible to get a starter with perfect stats. Do not worry. Totodile is not really a Pocket Monster, but a Monster, period.
categories.name: Manipless

games.description: Pokémon Gold Version is a game of the second generation of Pokémon. Taking place a few years after the events of Red and Blue, this is the only generation allowing you to go to the previous region and therefore face not 8, but 16 gym leaders. The Speedrun of this game revolves around the management of movements, menus and of course: decision making. We play with Kaiminus, the Water Starter, very strong thanks to Rage, his Level 7 attack.
games.name: Pokémon Crystal

categories.description: The flagship category of the game. The most used "trick" of the run is undoubtedly death abuse, allowing you to skip cutscenes or even reset the location of certain enemies.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This game is a Die & Retry based on Metal Slug gameplay. We embody the young Rise who, armed with Shine, his strange revolver, must save Gamearth from the invasion of the "Next Gen"! A graphically beautiful game, full of easter eggs. It is a very demanding speedrun in terms of execution. A single mistake means death, coupled with a painful waste of time.
games.name: Rise & Shine

categories.description: Because of equip glitch the speedrun of FF1 PSP is a very fast-paced run with minimal grinding. All Dungeons aims to showcase both the main game and all bonus dungeons. It's basically all bosses except without redoing dungeons to make for a better viewing experience.
categories.name: All dungeons

games.description: Final Fantasy 1 is the first game in the final fantasy series and probably one of the hardest. The PSP version of the game however is unique to an equipment glitch allowing the player to get stronger equipment very early on in the game.
games.name: Final Fantasy 1

categories.description: Any% WM or Any% with Wondermail is essentially the main story with being able to generate items whenever and wherever we want. We mostly make use of this to make the run significantly safer past the first 3 dungeons. This being a roguelike this is the safest way to consistently run this.
categories.name: Any% WM

games.description: PMD Explorers of Time is a roguelike Pokémon game. We play a human turned Pokémon and have to work our way through randomly generated dungeons in an attempt to figure out what is going on. Ultimately we find out time as we know it is about to stop resulting in a full paralazyz of the world. We, along with our trusty partner set out on the ultimate quest to stop this from happening
games.name: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time

categories.description: The most popular GS category. No S&Q bans RNG manipulation and removes major glitches for an "authentic" GS experience. Runners must use their knowledge of encounters to clear them efficiently while making appropriate risk/reward judgments to go fast.
categories.name: Any% No Save & Quit

games.description: A fan favorite JRPG for the GBA, recently released on SwitchVC. Features blisteringly crisp menus and a soundtrack for the ages composed by Motoi Sakuraba. SwitchVC version saves 16s per hour, has a lower overall lag profile, and rewind in case things go really wrong. Since the last time showcased, major sequences breaks were discovered using poison that completely rerouted the midgame and cut a boss, saving about 12 minutes overall.
games.name: Golden Sun

categories.description: The main category for this game. No S&Q removes RNG manip and major glitches to provide an 'authentic' golden sun experience that tests a runners depth of knowledge of the game. Major reroutes and a new glitch since the last time showcase have saved ~10 minutes.
categories.name: Any% No Save & Quit

games.description: Widely considered the best game in the Golden Sun series and best JRPG for the GBA, The Lost Age has the greatest depth and strategical planning of any speedrun in the series and features blistering crisp menus with a soundtrack for the ages composed by Motoi Sakuraba. The 2024 SwitchVC version has faster framerate saving about 16s per hour, broadly lower lag everywhere, and rewind in case things go really wrong.
games.name: Golden Sun: The Lost Age

categories.description: No S&Q+ permits major glitches but keeps RNG manip mostly banned.  The resulting category gets Early Isaac, doubles him as a character, utilizes Death Storage to make significant sequence breaks, and beats the game without ever seeing the reunion. A very different GS experience.
categories.name: Any% No Save & Quit+

games.name: Golden Sun: The Lost Age

categories.description: We've seen plenty of unseeded runs Hades in marathon, but have yet to see anything from the Seeded side! The seeded category allows for the manipulation of RNG through the entire run to get a predictable,  fully optimized run through of the game! Think of a TAS showcase but a human runner!
categories.name: Seeded AnyHeat (Routed)

games.description: Hades is a god-like rogue-like dungeon crawler that combines the best aspects of Supergiant's critically acclaimed titles, including the fast-paced action of Bastion, the rich atmosphere and depth of Transistor, and the character-driven storytelling of Pyre.
games.name: Hades

categories.description: A lot of areas in the game require some number of shine sprites (the game's main collectible), or having specific Bowser keys, to unlock. Most notably, entering the final Bowser stage requires 32 shine sprites. Although most of these requirements can be skipped, in this run, we follow all of them.
categories.name: No Major Skips

games.description: Super Mario 63 is a Flash game from 2009 heavily inspired by Super Mario 64, Sunshine,  and Galaxy, bringing the sandbox-like worlds from those games down to two dimensions. Its many movement options, combined with the existence of all 3 FLUDDs, make for an entertaining speedgame with a high skill ceiling!
games.name: Super Mario 63

categories.description: Collect all 64 shine sprites, 64 star coins, and 3 Bowser keys in the game.

categories.description: In this category we collect half of the Bees availible in the game creating a fast-paced run across both all the Overworld (consisting several sequence breaks and cool tricks) aswell as 20 of the flowy 2-D levels and a really hard boss-level (consistent) at the end.
categories.name: 24 Bees

games.description:
The game is a 2D Platformer with a 2.5D Overworld, that has free movement and its own tricks and glitches.
There are 48 Bees in the game, 40 of which are to be collected by finishing levels and 8 to be found in the overworld.
Movement in through the overworld consists of interesting looking and varied movement tricks that allow us to access all areas of the game through sequence breaks, while the levels themselves are mostly flowy, fast-paced 2-D Platforming that is satisfying to look at.
games.name: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair

categories.description: In this category we only move across the Overworld of the game with the goal to collect all 8 Bees that are availible on the Overworld of the game, without entering any of the 2-D levels. It's a fun showcase of all the movement tricks and sequence breaks existing for the overworld in short form.
categories.name: Overworld Bees

categories.description: Bingo offers a fresh perspective on a speedgame by making you complete a set of goals generated on a 5x5 grid. The 1v1 lockout variant allows for interactivity and mindgames as player react to their opponent's choices. The layout and mechanics of Sunshine makes it the perfect lockout bingo game.
categories.name: 1vs.1 Lockout Bingo

games.description: Super Mario Sunshine is a rushed piece of software plagued by some questionable level design at times, and yet has perhaps the best character movement of any 3D platformer ever. This combined with very open world -esque progression as well as the infamous blue coins makes it the perfect playground of both routing and execution, which makes for a very flashy showcase. The added jank every once in a while does not hurt (the viewer) either
games.name: Super Mario Sunshine

categories.description: Ninja is the name the community gave tracks that were harder than anything in the base game. They require extreme precision, consistency and even exploiting quirks of the physics engine. I'll show off what Extreme looks like, and then multiple levels of Ninja difficulty on community made tracks.
categories.name: Ninja Showcase

games.description: Trials Rising is a 2D physics platformer, where you navigate obstacles uses your trials bike. It has an absurdly high skill ceiling and a fantastic track editor which players have used to push the have pushed the limits of the game and themselves.
games.name: Trials Rising

categories.description: Any% Warps resolves around the Warps glitch which lets us teleport through the game via the map screen. It's a breakneck speed, constant movement, no downtime deconstruction of the game.
categories.name: Any% Warps

games.description: Dust: An Elysian Tail is a beautiful metroidvania with loads of movement tech and skips/glitchles to let us zoom through the game.
games.name: Dust: An Elysian Tail

categories.description: DP Any% goes by quickly, which makes it very beginner friendly but also one where RNG manipulation is the key to saving time. We do a specific RNG manipulation in order to get a Chimchar with amazing stats and the best Hidden Power type, and also no wild encounters before we have access to repels!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Set in the Sinnoh region, Pokémon Diamond/Pearl were the first main series games in the franchise on released for Nintendo DS. The DS games have fantastic ways of doing RNG manipulation for very long periods of time, and can be blown apart with the powerful tweaking glitch. This makes the any% category one of the quickest Pokémon speedruns.
games.name: Pokémon Pearl

categories.description: Platinum Any% is maybe the coolest category in the DS games. No longer can you warp to the Hall of Fame, so we get to glitch through the Sinnoh region in full, collecting 7 or 8 badges depending on how we feel. Major developments have been made to the route to make Golduck the king of Sinnoh!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Set in the Sinnoh region, Pokémon Platinum was the third version succeeding Diamond/Pearl as the first main series games in the franchise on released for Nintendo DS. The DS games have fantastic ways of doing RNG manipulation for very long periods of time, and can be blown apart with the powerful tweaking glitch. Especially in Platinum, after Game Freak nerfed the impact of tweaking to make the run longer and much more interesting.
games.name: Pokémon Platinum

categories.description: The Manipless (No RNG Manipulation) category is currently the most popular Pokémon DS category as it's very beginner friendly, while also requiring lots of skill to master. We use our trusty Cyndaquil until we are gifted the amazing Kenya the Spearow, and finally go on the hunt for a mythical fish.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless Manipless

games.description: Pokémon HG/SS are remakes of the iconic Gold/Silver, released in 2009. We venture through the Johto region, and are eventually able to reach the Kanto region after becoming the Champion! After getting 16 badges, one final battle remains...
games.name: Pokémon HeartGold

categories.description: The Manipless (No RNG Manipulation) category is very popular among DS speedrunners as it's very accessible, while also requiring lots of skill to master. Our team will include Cyndaquil, Fearow?? and a legendary fish! Tweaking allows us to perform plenty of skips, but this makes Red and Blue tough!
categories.name: Any% Manipless

games.description: Pokémon HG/SS are remakes of the iconic Gold/Silver, released in 2009. We venture through the Johto region, and are eventually able to reach the Kanto region after becoming the Champion! After getting 16(actually 5) badges, one final battle remains...
games.name: Pokémon HeartGold

categories.description: Any% Glitchless aims to become the Champion. Team Aqua and Team Magma are causing mayhem in the Hoenn region and must be stopped. We collect 8 badges, save the world from a massive disaster and try to beat the new Champion, Wallace! One of the best Pokémon speedgames in my opinion!
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description: Pokémon Emerald is perhaps the most beloved Pokémon game of all time, and it's simultaneously an amazing speedgame! You've got RNG manipulation, Teleportation, the Mach Bike and Rayquaza at your disposal in the fantastic Hoenn region.
games.name: Pokémon Emerald

categories.description: A complete run around the entire island, collecting everything we can see as fast as possible! 100% completion requires the collection of all 47 golden balloons, all minigame keys, all golden trophies, both completed amulets, and beating both versions of the final boss, Wizpig! Large skips included.

games.description: Fast paced kart racing game featuring 3 unique vehicles (Car, Hovercraft and Plane) each with their own mechanics and handling techniques, bundled together in a bright and colorful adventure on Timber's Island.  Travel around the island to collect golden balloons to challenge each of the world's bosses to work towards taking down Wizpig. Expect to see tight racing lines, large skips and out of bounds movement, and maybe some randomness here and there to keep everyone on their toes!
games.name: Diddy Kong Racing

categories.description: Collect the T.T. Amulet by winning all the minigames around the island! The wrong warp will not be used in this run, and is it's own sub-category. Tight driving, accompanied with expert routing to collect all the minigame keys and the complete T.T. Amulet!
categories.name: T.T. Amulet (No Wrong Warp)

categories.description: This category's goal is to clear the game as fast as we can from a fresh file, every glitch and skips allowed. There is a lot of skips used such as sequence breaks or OOB's which makes this category really cool to watch.
categories.name: NG Any%

games.description: Okami is a 3D adventure game where you play Okami Amaterasu (also called Amy in the communtiy) the sun and life goddess to banish yokaïs which invaded Nippon in your absence. Your main characteristic is your celestial brush which allows you to draw multiple things and interact with the environment and help you defeat ennemies, clear dungeons and help citizens.
games.name: Okami HD

categories.description: Pay Off Debt is our any% category. It is hard-as-nails, challenging runners to route randomly generated levels on the fly and to keep track of a towering mental stack. It also features tons of flashy and scary-looking strategies which will leave spectators at the edge of their seats.
categories.name: Pay Off Debt

games.description:
Pikmin 2 is the odd one out of the Pikmin series. Olimar is tasked with returning to the planet he was just stranded on to repay his company's enormous debt with the help of the cute little carrot guys. A cult classic in a popular series with a staunch fanbase, Pikmin 2 is sure to attract a lot of attention and donations for charity. 
Detailed pitch in this vid: https://youtu.be/10lV7uxRByY. The "video link" entry is co-commentary I did for a race, showcasing my energy and entertainment skills.
games.name: Pikmin 2

categories.description: Main category of the game. No glitches, as the name suggests. Clear all 6 zones to open up the castle and evict Wario. Compared to my last solo run at ESA, 16 out of 21 levels have received strat updates, despite SML2 seemingly being a straight-forward jump'n'run game.
categories.name: Glitchless

games.description: Mario's 2nd adventure on a handheld, beloved by all. Between general movement optimization and abusing the mechanics to our advantage (superjumps, cornerboosts, bunnyswimming, permafluttering), the community has been cooking to tackle the last few time saves in the game by employing creative mashing techniques for faster boss kills and novel strats to defeat that pesky ever-looming Game Boy lag. At the same time, more and more consistency strats emerge, which is pretty handy for marathon runs.
games.name: Super Mario Land 2 - 6 Golden Coins

categories.description: Make your way to the princess and back to the throne room as fast as possible for a happy ending. You collect your starter kit of jelly beans in the first room and skip all other upgrades. We don't need those because we can glitch through solid floors and balance on the edge of a bubbling cauldron!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Video game legend David Crane's (Dragster, Pitfall!) first Game Boy game. The gimmick is that your blob can turn into all kinds of objects if you feed him the right flavor of jelly bean. You're supposed to utilize that mechanic to traverse obstacles and deadly traps, collect more jelly beans and puzzle forth all the way until you rescue the eponymic princess. The speedrun cuts that journey way short by glitching through masonry and finding workarounds where more jellybeans would be in order.
games.name: The Rescue of Princess Blobette

categories.description: Full game speedrun, From start to finish. No fast traveling or major glitches. Relay Run with 6 different runners.
categories.name: Any% Classic (No om0)

games.description: Open World Action Adventure game by Rockstar Games. You will probably have heard of this game.
games.name: GTA V

categories.description: This category has no restrictions on any speedtech.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Contrary to what the title suggests, Jedi Outcast is actually the predecessor to Jedi Academy. Built on the same engine (Quake3) it offers the same core movement of airstrafing and bunnyhopping but without the need to circumvent velocity reduction upon landing a jump. This makes Jedi Outcast a more traditional strafejumping-oriented speedrun. Nonetheless it offers a plethora of unique mechanics, skips and tricks that make it fantastic to run to both play and watch.
games.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast

categories.description:
This category comes with three aditional missions that are normally skipped in Any%.
Also I'd be running No Stablaunch which means we'd get to show off a whole bunch of insane strats that are skipped with Stablauch. (broken vehicles, OOB areas, crazy chains, force grip flying, etc.)
categories.name: All Levels - No Stablaunch

games.description: Built on a heavily modified Quake3 engine, Jedi Academy not only offers bunnyhopping and airstrafing but also comes with several unique movement mechanics that really make it stand out. In addition to the movement tech there is a plethora of amazing tricks the community was able to work out over the years that are just as flashy as they are difficult. Anything from OOB skips, broken vehicle mechanics, AI manipulation, broken Force Powers, engine quirks, etc. you name it.
games.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy

categories.description: No poker like the category say : you are not allow to play mini game. We pay the debt in the game, and to pay that debt we beat what we called : elite monsters (gigantos) who are powerful monsters with lot of HP.  When we beat them, we gain lot of moneycto pay our debt and advance at next chapter.

We have few runkillers like : Volt and Siennabronc who's the highlight of the run (mandatory gigantos) to beat the game. In the game we pay the debt all along the game.

games.description: Since there is no Stream 2 non gaming activety, I would like to try this out over there. This is a serie where runners at the event record an attempt of a certain strat WHICH MAY SUCCEED BUT ALSO FAIL. The clip will pause on the first frame of the attempt.  The crowd and chat gets to guess if the runner nailed it or failed it. the clip will be rewinded and played normally afterwards to see the results.
games.name: Will It Clip

categories.name: True Ending (Merciless)

games.description: Remake of the first PS2 era Persona game, modernized with plenty of new features and graphics resulting in being the fastest selling Persona game to date.  Comparatively to older Persona games, the speedrun's length has a good middle ground between not being too long and boring or not being too fast and broken to not be interesting enough.
games.name: Persona 3 Reload

categories.description: Obtains best ending while playing on "hardest" difficulty. Shows off a lot more depth than easier difficulties, making for a much more interesting run for both, runner and viewers. (Video taken from PS5 run which is around 1 hour slower than PC)
categories.name: Hard, True Ending

games.description: Persona 5 Royal added even more to the bar and even gave the speedrun a whole new route with all its additions. Similar to P5, Royal also has its own share of fancy OoB clips that are implemented in to the route but suffer the same issue of the game's nature, giving the run a bit of downtime in between dungeons. However, Royal speeds up a lot of those sections thankfully. P5R has recently been ported to more modern systems, making the run even faster and cutting non gameplay time down a lot.
games.name: Persona 5 Royal

categories.description:
This showcase is similar to the Mario Battle Royale Showcase from ESA Summer 2023: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5_BCb4PrSe0
Stages can be seen here: https://youtu.be/3ZOCtF9LTK4?si=mI3UTMYsvfxOyhcK
Rounds go until a racer wins 3 tracks, the hard cap time limit can change based on tech needs.
categories.name: Multiplayer Competition Showcase

games.description: Micro Machines is a 4 player SNES game where players race around a track trying to take the other racers out. Points are gained by being the last remaining vehicle. There are 30 tracks and players get to compete in cars, trucks, buggies, boats, helicopters, and more. Rounds will be tallied to determine the final overall winner in an annual ESA pastime that can be heard from the hallways as the practice room fills with miniature racers.
games.name: Micro Machines 2: Turbo Tournament

categories.description: This category is a Co-op run that was first created earlier this year. The Any% run has a robust leaderboard, but this Co-op version reduces some of the RNG and also required some improv ad what 1 player does affects what will happen on your teammates next attempt at an action.
categories.name: 2p Any%

games.description: Join not 1 but 2 Harrys as this Co-op runs dives deep into the caves to save Rhonda. Super Pitfall is infamous for its cryptic secrets, including invisible warps, fake enemies, and hidden pickups. The main event of this run is the wall glitch, where runners leave it up to fate to determine how long it will take Harry to squish through the wall and glitch onto the other side. This Co-op category increases the chaos and throws a whole dimension to the adventure.
games.name: Super Pitfall

categories.description: In this category you compete against several opponents, with each one getting harder and using new special attacks. Each difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard) has 3 different enemies to defeat.
categories.name: Easy-Hard (Controller)

games.description: Pieces is what happens when you combine a fighting game with a jigsaw puzzle. In this run you race against increasingly difficult opponents to complete the puzzles while you both attempt to power up your meter in order to perform special attacks on each other. This leads to scenarios where you have reversed controls, invisible pieces, radar ability, and even a broom that sweeps your enemies pieces off the board.
games.name: Pieces

categories.description: In the "No Red Propeller" category of the Inspector Gadget,  we take on Dr. Claw's minions without the aid of the trusty red propeller which instantly kills bosses and enemies, adding an extra layer of difficulty and strategy to the gameplay akin to a hard mode.
categories.name: No Red Propeller

games.description: Go Go Gadget SNES! This quirky platformer is a rush of weapon and gadget swapping, with some humor mixed in. Not only will we be searching various worlds to find the captured Penny, this run will not use the Red Propeller, which instantly defeats enemies and bosses.
games.name: Inspector Gadget

categories.description: This relay would be 14 players on each team, each given a stage determined mainly by experience. This category uses the US version of Mega Man to be able to utilize the Normal difficulty of the game. Video provided is the 2019 relay race, example run here: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/254531902
categories.name: Any% (Normal)

games.description: 5 years ago the retro crew electrified ESA and the gaming world in the Mega Man 1 relay where 30 runners each completed a stage in a relay race. That means it is time for the next level, as Prisi, Apollo & Friends look to host the Mega Man 2 relay race. 2 powerhouse teams of 14 players each will race to defeat the return of Dr. Wily.
games.name: Mega Man 2

categories.description: Any% No WM No QS means wondermail and quicksaves are not allowed. This means no RNG manip and no free items to help us out. This spices up the run a lot and makes it a very entertaining watch as we never know what we will encounter in a dungeon. If needed we can rng manip to make sure we finish.
categories.name: Any% No WM No QS

games.description: PMD Blue Rescue Team is a roguelike Pokémon game. The world is being hit by natural disasters creating mystery dungeons and causing pokémon to be in need of rescuing. We play a human turned Pokémon together with our partner to form a Rescue Team.  Together they go rescue pokémon in need and investigate the true cause of these disasters. This journey takes them through perilous mountains, deepest caves, and dungeons in the sky to reach our goal.
games.name: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blue Rescue Team

categories.description: Finish the game as fast as possible without using the zip glitch (zips are no fun and very marathon unsafe)
categories.name: Any% Zipless (Normal Difficulty)

games.description: Wario Land 4 is a fast-paced puzzle platformer. Wario, due to his own greed, gets trapped in a pyramid and has to escape, also just happens to save a princess on his way out. The run is almost entirely skill dependent - there is very little luck involved. Lots of tight jumps, speed management and precise tricks though!
games.name: Wario Land 4

categories.description:
We've been discussing potential games to include, and we're currently considering the following
Super Mario Bros - Chip N' Dale: Rescue Rangers - Castlevania - Mike Tyson's Punch-Out!! (Tyson only) - Contra - Ducktales - Batman: The Video Game - Super Mario Bros 2
categories.name: Donation Shuffler

games.description: This is a 3v3 race where several games are raced concurrently, instantly swapping between games as soon as a donation comes in.  Think the "Brosentia shuffler", but two in sync. A team can swap controller between members whenever they like, to (try to) optimize who plays depending on who's the best with a certain game or segment. When one team beats a game, it is taken out of the pool of available swap targets. When all games are beaten, the team with the most beaten games wins.
games.name: NES Shuffler Race

categories.description: Collect the optional carrot on each stage, to unlock the special ending cutscene.
categories.name: All Carrots (100%)

games.description: Gruniozerca 2 is a NES homebrew that was developed in 2017 by two guys (Lukasz Kurr and M-Tee). It is a puzzle platformer, where the core mechanic is picking up blocks of various shapes in the stages, and then use those blocks to create platforms. In each stage you have to collect all keys to open the door to the next stage. Each stage also has an optional collectible carrot. If you collect all carrots, you get a special ending. The game is avalible for free (https://mteegfx.itch.io/grunio2)
games.name: Gruniozerca 2 - The Great Cavy Rescue

categories.description: The Game is played on legendary which is the hardest difficulty of the game. no glitches or routes are disallowed for this category.
categories.name: Halo: Reach Legendary

games.description: Reach Legendary has moderate amounts of out of bounds and quite a few tricks. Since its on legendary there is a large focus on combat which can be quite spooky at times.
games.name: Halo: Reach

categories.description: The goal is to beat the last bosses of both the DLC and the base game from a fresh savefile. The cool part about this is that we can make use of the DLC character, Ms Chalice, on the bosses in the base game which lets us make use of some spicier strats than just base game Any%!
categories.name: DLC + Base Game Any%

games.description: Cuphead is a 2D platformer with classic run 'n gun gameplay (think Contra, Metal Slug), and its visuals + audio is heavily inspired by 1930s cartoons which is done incredibly well. The DLC was released in 2022 and brought some new and interesting bosses for us to beat fast.
games.name: Cuphead

categories.description: Arcade Mode is the story mode of this game, so this is basically just Any%. It's played on the Normal difficulty, and we play as a Gun character which is your standard run 'n gun character (there are also Ninja characters which focus more on close range attacks, but that has its own category).
categories.name: Arcade Mode (Normal) - Gun

games.description: Blazing Chrome is a run 'n gun type of game made with inspiration from classics such as Contra and Metal Slug. Just like in those games, you die in one hit and can lose your equipped weapon and power-ups, so deaths can be very punishing in this butt-clenching speedrun.
games.name: Blazing Chrome

categories.description: As the category name says, you need to beat the game from start to finish in a new save file with no prior upgrades. The run is routed to start with the stages where we pick up the most useful upgrades/weapons as early as possible to speed up the movement and boss fights later on.
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: A retro-style action platformer with similarities to the Shinobi games and some Mega Man-esque game mechanics. There's a lot of focus on fluid movement and good platforming while also optimally using the powers/weapons you get from the bosses at the end of every stage. Oh, and the soundtrack slaps all the way through.
games.name: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider

categories.description: This is the usual Any% category, just beat the game on Normal or above difficulty by any means necessary except for using passwords. If I game over or the game crashes (which is rare, but can happen and is accounted for in the estimate) I will use passwords if needed to get back to where I was.
categories.name: Any% (Normal/Hard)

games.description: Maui Mallard in Cold Shadow (or Donald in Maui Mallard, as it was marketed in Europe) was first released on Genesis. The PC port is essentially a polished version of the Genesis game, and is a bit different when it comes to level design and gameplay compared to the SNES version which came later. It's an action platformer which has its fair share of clips, zips, and other skips, along with questionable hitboxes and jankiness in general.
games.name: Maui Mallard in Cold Shadow

categories.description: Beat the last bosses of both the DLC and the base game from a fresh savefile with the least amount of completion possible. This means we can't do/get anything that's optional and will have to beat the DLC with only the starter weapon. Fortunately we can still play as Ms Chalice!
categories.name: DLC + Base Game Low%

games.description: Cuphead is a 2D platformer with classic run 'n gun gameplay (think Contra, Metal Slug), and its visuals + audio is heavily inspired by 1930s cartoons which is done incredibly well. The DLC was released in 2022 and brought some new and interesting bosses for us to beat fast.
games.name: Cuphead

categories.description: All Moons showcases essentially what the entire game has to offer. It includes hours of entirely new routes/movement compared to what often gets showcased in a marathon setting like Any% (and even other recent All Moons runs), all at a WR level (and maybe it will be broken in this showcase ;)).
categories.name: All Moons

games.description: Super Mario Odyssey is the latest installment in the 3D Mario group of games, popular in speedrunning and known for its smooth yet complicated movement that serves as eye candy for the viewers. It largely contains fast-paced gameplay without much downtime in between each collectible (moons), and with the extremely flexible movement options, it remains as one of the more consistent 3D Mario games to run (and has great opportunity for some crazy saves).
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: The Full Game Speedrun showcases every gameplay option this game has to offer. The regular Any% run is followed up by the three DLCs for this game, each more difficult than the previous one. All of this culminates in a 15 minute Boss Rush with some of the game's hardest bosses.
categories.name: Full Game Speedrun

games.description: SoP:FFO is a Final Fantasy Game with the playstyle similar to the Nioh games.  You have Souls-like elements like the typical "dance" with the games bigger bosses and various levels each referencing a different FF game. Those levels usually contain a few puzzles that need to be solved to then defeat the upcoming boss of the stage, each enemy being fought in a different manner depending on it's specifications and weaknesses.
games.name: Stranger of Paradise: Final Fantasy Origins

categories.description: The run involves countless of fights with various strats and ideas thrown in, all of it leading up to the Superboss Minerva which usually takes players ages to unlock. This run showcases the progression from the lowest Powerlevel all the way to a level high enough to beat everything in this game.
categories.name: Beat Minerva

games.description: CCFFVIIR is the prequel to FF7. It's an Action RPG featuring all the regular FF7 stuff like Materia, Shinra and the Buster Sword.
games.name: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion

categories.description: The Co-Op run allows for strategic maneuvers throughout the levels due to the cooperative nature of the run. Puzzles can be rearranged or straight up skipped and bosses are getting juggled between the three players of the run.

categories.name: All Chalices

games.description: MediEvil: Resurrection is a Remake of the original MediEvil for the PS1. It reimagines the game in a completly new way from it's core game mechanics to it's level and bosses, even it's characters. It offers a great showcase for a speedrun as this game has lots of tricks and skips making it a fast paced and adventurous game to watch and play.

categories.description:
In the Quest Mode: All Quests category of Bejeweled 3, your objective is to unearth 5 relics by completing 8 mini-games per relic as quickly as possible. 
The minigames cycle, but with increased difficulty as you progress through the relics.  We use various techniques to speed up our progress.
categories.name: All Quests

games.description:
Bejeweled 3 is a Match-3 Game, like its predecessors. 
However, this third installment in the series adds more game modes, mixing up the traditional formula, adding things such as poker, butterflies, and even a zen-mode.

In most Bejeweled 3 runs, your aim is to complete a game mode as quickly as possible, but there are also a few runs that are essentially score attacks. 
For a simple match-3 game, there's a plethora of cool strats like gemwipes, aerials, and some even more advanced techniques!
games.name: Bejeweled 3

categories.description: All Puzzle Pieces requires collecting every optional puzzle piece, one in each level. The routing differs from Any%, often taking us to  completely different parts of the levels. The 9-headed easy mode is not available, increasing the challenge. NG+ skips cutscenes and allows for choosing costumes.
categories.name: All Puzzle Pieces (New Game+)

games.description: Kubinashi Recollection is a Touhou fangame solo developed by legendary Touhou fan musician and artist Paradot (a.k.a. Zenerat). The game is a 2D puzzle platformer with great visuals and phenomenal music and features 10 worlds, with each world introducing a new type of puzzle gimmick. The main speedrun technique that really opens up this game is the ability to jump on and frame-perfectly also pick up the object to completely bypass many of the game's intended puzzle solutions.
games.name: Kubinashi Recollection

categories.name: Any% (Co-Op)

games.description:
Digimon World 4 is a hack&slash adventure game  where you control a digimon exploring an unfamiliar world. There are tons of dungeons and bosses to find and you can even play with your friends!
The speedrun starts off clipping OoB to reach a later dungeon to get quick level ups and unlock the "final dungeon" of World 1, after that we grind for levels in world 2 then perform a very precise trick to sequence break to the final World, from there it's an intense dungeon & boss rush to the end.
games.name: Digimon World 4

categories.description:
Blackout Bingo means to complete a generated 5x5 bingo board (25 total goals), some different goals could be "collect 30 different gold skulltulas", "beat the Water Temple" etc. 
Doing it co-op with someone also allows you to route 2 very different playthroughs that becomes a great showcase!

games.description:
Ocarina of Time is an all time classic RPG and speedruns of it have transformed it into an incredible sandox of glithes and overall speed-tech allowing for some really unique and different routes/categories.
I've always loved messing around with different glitches in this game and would love to showcase some of the incredible things in this game and I think the best way of doing that is through a "Blackout Bingo". This involves 
generating a set of 25 goals and completing all of them!
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

categories.description: The category consists of beating the second story DLC without using any supernatural powers. games.description: It's Sonic 2 but with an added extra feature. Crowd Control! We'll attempt to do glitches and skips but with the audience actively participating they'll be much harder to land than usual!
games.name: Sonic The Hedghog 2

categories.description: Complete the game with Sonic & Tails collecting the chaos emeralds and finishing with the bonus final level. (Submission video has a 5 min elevator pitch that showcases best parts of the run)
categories.name: S&T Good Ending - No Major Glitches

games.description: Sonic Mania is fast, speedy and fun. This category showcases the game without any of the major glitches that skip through parts of levels & certain bosses. We'll see everything the game has to offer and is still filled with movement tech and the elemental shields to keep the momentum going. Plus we'll be speeding our way through the special stages to get the chaos emeralds in SECONDS.
games.name: Sonic Mania

categories.description: Developed by Alistair Aitcheson, the Magic Box now includes a Boss Rush Shuffler mode. We'll take on all 42 bosses from the Classic Trilogy, with 4, 8 or All of them at a time. The bosses shuffle each time you hit them. It's chaotic, random, and a real test of a speedrunner's memory and reactions!
categories.name: Boss Rush Shuffler

games.description: The Sonic Classic Trilogy includes Sonic 1, Sonic 2, and Sonic 3 & Knuckles for the SEGA Genesis. Timeless classics from our childhoods!
games.name: Sonic Classic Trilogy

categories.description: This mod has so many special extra maps, lost chapters and so on that showing it all wouldn't really make sense. So this run would be limited to the main maps from the main level hub (top floor). A selection of extra maps could be added through donation incentives.
categories.name: Easy Run (Top Floor)

games.description: Probably the best and grandest scale Quake mod out there. New maps, monsters and items all bundled up in such a tasteful way to build a fantastic atmosphere. Created by a large community team of level designers, artists and coders, so would be a great showcase for the still thriving Quake mapping community. Especially since the speedrun still features the fast-paced gameplay with bunnyhopping and damage boosting that Quake is so famous for.
games.name: Quake: Arcane Dimensions

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Chef Cookie must navigate through his cursed restaurant to foil the wicked Ohdove (which is like saying "Hors D'Oeuvre" with a cold). On his way he dispatches anthropomorphic food items with deadly kitchen utensils.
games.name: Panic Restaurant

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Moon Crystal is a platformer only released in Japan where you play as a boy on a quest to save his family. The mechanics of the game are slightly reminiscent of Ninja Gaiden and Prince of Persia, with rather detailed animation.
games.name: Moon Crystal

categories.description: Like any beat em'up it is the most fun on hard, cause you get more, faster and stronger enemies and bosses. Memorizing spawns, remember the correct spawns, and getting a bit lucky is what you really need for this run.
categories.name: Hard

games.description: Sailor moon beat em up game. Memorizing spawns, manipulating movement to stack enemies up, stunlocking them. Needing to know where the spawning points are cause the screen can still scroll after "locked", so you need to move great distances to get optimal and fast screen clears. Fighting famous sailor vilians through out the game, as well as enemies. Ride the all time classic "Beat em up elevator", Go through candy land, get on top of a moving truck, and travel all around. Also Tuxedo Mask.
games.name: Bishoujo senshi sailor moon genesis

categories.description: The game is on something I call "threadmill" rng, so for a optimal run you start on a good frame, to setup stage 1. After that there are still predictable rng but thrown in is unpredictable rng with the spheres. Very few WR sub 10 finish, but a safe sub 12 is more likely.
categories.name: 1 loop

games.description: NES Black Box game known for its high difficulty. Arcade racing, where the goal is to reach the goal in 10 stages. Between each stage you can decide between A or B route, by doing this you can pick the easier stages. I'll be honest, there's no guarantee in this run. You get the super bike in the first stage and then you hope to not die.There are a few stages with "Spheres" which are completly random, but most of them can be avoided. If you want to see my heart rate go up to 150+, here's the game
games.name: Mach Rider

categories.description: In the beat up stages we wanna despawns enemies, and setup the items(armor vest and stick/whip) that you'll keep as well as you don't die. in the shooting stages catch "cycles" and racing stages to survive. This is a really hard game that even stumbles speedrunner's at times(US version).
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: A konami game that tried to push limits. 3 different gaming experinces packed into 1 game. Beat em up, Zapper/shoter stage, and driving. US version is harder, too hard so they made the Japanese version way easier. One of the truly hard games on NES, features despawn strats, cycle manipulation on shoting stages, and hoping that the car bullets works! Enemies in the US version has a lot more health, making the game feel almost realistic.
games.name: Adventure of Bayou Billy/Mad City

categories.description: 7 stages, a lot of sub weapons(Beams, grenades, bomerangs), a lot of utility skills(Flying, heal, armor). Going through this run we will be low leveled, and only stopping to do 2 grinds only cause the game forces us. Health management, exp (re)routing based on what happens, and more.
categories.name: Beat the game, No WW

games.description: This is a famicom only released metroidvania game. It has a EXP system with level ups, as well as a weapon leveling system. You can power up your "cosmo armor" to get more defense, you get sub weapons/items(heal, fly, and more), and a lot of blades to aid you threw this stage based metroidvania game. The game features quick movement, dark room exploration, a few grinds and an amazing soundtrack. Can be played with the J translation patch as default for better viewer experince.
games.name: Cosmo Police Galivan

categories.description: We wanna keep the momentum and keep running, you can do a turn around and keep running, however it is one "input cycle"(1-3 frames depending) tight. Killing and collecting points to make sure we refill ESP at correct spots to keep going fast, and upgrading our weapons and sub powers.
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: One of the most fast paced platformer on the master system. Almost a mega man clone where you get new weapons and power up after each stage. 4 Weapons, 4 power ups, Healing shield, Flying, Screen clear and stage restart(that we avoid). Momentum running makes movement important to keep running speed, only being able to swap weapons while game is running forces you to quick swaps while jumping to maintain your forward momentum, and a score route to keep your ESP energy high makes this run amazing.
games.name: Psychic World

categories.description: Any% is the only category for the game. We beat every level as fast as possible with no restrictions.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Yume Penguin Monogatari is a obscure, charming platformer for Famicom. You play as Penta Penguin and the goal of the game is to win back his girlfriend Pentaro by going through platforming/flight stages while collecting "slim drinks" to loose weight while the enemies try to force-feed you. The game has been raced two times prior at ESA (2016/2018) and since they say the third time is the charm we are hoping that 2024 is the year of Penta after a 6 year hiatus. Submitting as a race vs CartinaCow
games.name: Yume Penguin Monogatari

categories.description: Cutscene% gives the most complete experience of the game. It prevents any cutscenes from being skipped, meaning that people who don't know the game will still get to experience the full story and all of the originality and charm the game has to offer. It is a very chill run with few choke points.
categories.name: Cutscene%

games.description:
The Neverhood is a point-and-click adventure game from 1996. Its unique claymation art style and music makes it stand out massively from to its contemporaries. It has a bit of a cult following, albeit a small one.
While some of the puzzles have the same solution every time, a bunch of the puzzles have an RNG component. This means that certain puzzles have potential for big time saves or time losses. It keeps the game fresh and novel in every run. The speedrun is fairly easy to pick up and learn.
games.name: The Neverhood

categories.description: Any% in A Bug's Life is a fairly straightforward run where each level has to be completed to get to the next. It features a couple of sequence breaks that allow portions of levels to be skipped, but overall does a good job of showcasing the whole game.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A Bug's Life is a 1998 puzzle platformer released for the original PlayStation,  based on the Disney/Pixar film of the same name. You play as the ant Flik as he tries to save his colony from the treacherous grasshoppers.  The game features 15 levels where you collect grain, plant seeds, and kill big bugs. It's a short and sweet game that is beloved by the PlayStation Nation.
games.name: A Bug's Life

categories.description: Daxter's biggest test of endurance: by the game's own count, 101% requires collecting all 1,000* orbs and 609 skull gems, defeating the final boss, and even reaching high scores on all the bonus mini-games, but oddly not completing any of the main missions, which leaves room for a couple fun skips!

games.description: Spin-off of the 3D platformer series Jak & Daxter, Daxter is one of PSP's biggest classics, but its very linear sequence greatly limits its speedrun potential... At least it would, if not for an arsenal of glitches ranging from phasing through collision, to launching high above the map, to straight up teleportation!
games.name: Daxter

categories.description: All Tournaments involves beating all 13 Tournaments to finish the game! This category have a lot of gimmicky races as the game progresses. Backwards driving and jumping allows us to do crazy skips on rather long tracks which are super cool!
categories.name: All Tournaments

games.description: Looney Tunes: Space Race is a Port from Dreamcast, that actually has some differences compared to what is available on the Dreamcast version, and also a very hype and interesting mechanic that was completely overlooked. The main movement of the game is DRIVING BACKWARDS. It has some interesting depth besides backwards driving, which will allow us to exploit a lot of tracks! Most tournaments are split with gimmicky races to create variation, that are very hard to deal with for Casual players!
games.name: Looney Tunes: Space Race

categories.description: Glicthless Any% requires beating the game as quickly as possible, while also only using the game's intended mechanics/knowledge of the game. Exploits, or glitches are not allowed. The category is timed using the game's in game timer.
categories.name: Glitchless Any%

games.description: 2d (J)RPG. Turn based combat, exploration, and dialogue heavy scenes.
games.name: Odyssey of Dremid'ir

categories.description: バグ無し (lit. No Bugs) has a focus on precise movements and clever trickery to save time. In the absence of common glitches like Early Master Sword or Boomerang Long Jump Attacks, the gameplay is very distinct from other mainline categories for the game. This category ends at Master Sword.
categories.name: バグ無し (Glitchless) Master Sword

games.description: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess follows Link and Midna on their quest to drive back the Twilight: an alternate dimension that tries to engulf the land of Hyrule. With the Triforce of Courage, Link has the power to transform into a wolf, granting him additional abilities to deal with the dangers they will face and save Hyrule!
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess

categories.description:
Golden Sun is all about menuing and precise movement, and so what better game to let a TAS ruin completely?
While a large portion of the run is cutscene, there's a lot going on in the background that can be talked about!
example commentary (different run) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7iAfhzHR-8g
categories.name: [TAS] Any% (Unrestricted)

games.description: Golden Sun is a JRPG from the early 2000s with a highly versatile class and magic system. The story follows Isaac and his childhood friend Garet as they set out to save the world from a great evil... or rather, that's what it would focus on, if it weren't for the boatload of glitches that allow you to skip most of it.
games.name: Golden Sun

categories.description:
I will solve about 700 problems to unlock all problems in "Q REMASTERED". 
Even though each problem can be solved in tens of seconds, the run takes four hours in total.
Enjoy the ceaseless rush of solutions!
categories.name: Unlock All

games.description:
"Q REMASTERED" is a simple puzzle game that anyone can enjoy! You can freely draw lines and shapes on the screen. The drawn object will fall down due to gravity. You will use the object to solve more than 1200 missions. (From Official Steam description)
The rules are very simple, but solving the problems is quite difficult.
games.name: Q REMASTERED

categories.description: As the de facto 100% category of Ratchet 2, we'll be collecting all platinum bolts, skill points, and items that carry between playthroughs.  The selling moment of this category comes a little over halfway through, when we utilize something akin to ACE that lets up upgrade every weapon in 5 minutes.
categories.name: Max%

games.description: Ratchet and Clank 2 on PS3 has quite a bit of sauce to it. With the charge boots, Ratchet is able to move and groove through levels at blinding speeds. Movement has to be calculated to a very specific degree, since spacing of movement depends on when the user pauses and unpauses the game. There's wall clips and out of bounds galore, and a diehard fanbase that'll bring the noise both in the chat and in the hotel.
games.name: Ratchet and Clank: Going Commando

categories.description: "Normal Route" implies to use the regular, main route the game expects you to go to from start to finish, including the factory part with turning rooms. However, as a potential donation incentive, I can offer to do Hard Route instead - blindfolded - which does not add any time to the estimate.
categories.name: Normal Route

games.description: Limbo is the first game release by Playdead, over 14 years ago on the XBOX 360. It has since been ported to any platform imaginable.  Limbo is a monochrome platformer where you play as a little boy who has entered Limbo to find his sister. Despite its age, the game still feels incredibly good, the controls and physics are on point. This allows for some neat tricks that can be abused for time saved throughout the run.
games.name: Limbo

categories.description: In Any% you need to reach the end of the game as fast as possible with every known skip and technique allowed. This includes the now popular "pushback" technique, abusing the 3rd, unintended dimension. I could do  the shock wave section blindfolded with commentary on my audio cues, adds ~3min.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Inside was released in 2016 as Playdead's second (and to date newest) game. While looking deceivingly similar to Limbo on first glance, there is a lot of difference in the way the game controls and feels. Especially the elements of game feel in a 2.5D game make perfect sense when playing casually, but once you know how they work, they offer the opportunity to be abused for time saves. In the past years more glitches were found which make the run really interesting and fund to watch.
games.name: Inside

categories.description: Aims to finish the game as fast as possible, using precise out of bounds trickery to skip levels and fights and optimize the required fights.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Modern first person shooter that is somewhat considered a "Doom Eternal-clone"
games.name: Shadow Warrior 3

categories.description: Run aims to finish the game as fast as possible without using zips/boosts
categories.name: Any% (no zips/boosts)

games.description: Prodeus is a fast paced first person shooter, emulating and resembling the feel of the original Doom and Quake.
games.name: Prodeus

categories.description: The randomizer switches main bosses for other main bosses and regular enemies for any other regular enemies. It also shuffles all items outside of the key ones, meaning we need to make a build on the spot. Not randomizing key items means we  can use a pre-determined path and control the estimate.
categories.name: 2 Player 1 Controller Any% Randomizer

games.description: Elden Ring will receive a DLC close to the end of June and with the uncertain future of speedruns, an item and enemy randomizer of the base game can still showcase the new DLC bosses and potentially DLC weapons in a more controlled format. 2 Player 1 Controller is a rare showcase and would be an exciting addition to an already interesting run.
games.name: Elden Ring

categories.description: The game has an ingame counter for percentage. The 100% category has to visit every area in all 5 chapters. We meet people from 2 years before, complete missions, play different minigames and defeat optional bosses to bring peace to Spira. The noCC category is close to the expericence of the PS2.

Yuna gets to see a sphere of a person who looks like Tidus, and she decides to look for clues about his whereabouts. Joining her are Rikku and Paine as a group of Sphere Hunters. But dark events are waiting in the shadows, threatening the world of Spira again.

categories.name: Any% NG+

games.description:
LCGOL is a spin off of the Tomb Raider series. It is an isometric twin-stick shooter with puzzles and platforming. This run features clips, OOB, Bomb boosting, spear warps, and more! We recently made new discoveries which will be shown in this updated run.  This link shows a recent run I did: https://youtu.be/Er1oGR11LTA 
SeductiveSpatula will be my commentator.
games.name: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light

categories.description: A brand new category created during ESA submission period, this has not been done anywhere else. This run uses placement glitch, which allows us to skip upgrades and needing to farm/raise animals to get through the world quicker. Finding Grandpa has never been faster!
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
NPLH is a relaxing farming and cleaning sim where you take on growing crops, raising animals, doing quests, and cleaning as you explore Earth to find your missing Grandpa. Use crops and animal products to help NPCs so they can guide you to the next area and get one step closer to finding Grandpa. Sometimes you're in a hurry though and don't want to waste time helping the locals. 
SeductiveSpatula will be my commentator.
games.name: No Place Like Home

categories.description: Glitchless is premium optimization of regular gameplay. We play on an earlier patch to avoid ducks (they're bad!). games.name: Final Fantasy III

categories.name: All Bosses
