categories.name: Any% Restricted NG+

games.description:
Sequel to Fallen Order, with a more open world feel with fast travels with a nice polish and extension to it's length, but the run is shorter than JFO. Respawn decided to let us skip cutscenes (yay) and we found a way to very early reach the last boss and finish the runs in glitched any% categories. The game is one year old and I've featured it's run in plenty of french marathons, but it's still new to ESA or even GDQ.
Could be part of a Bifecta with Fallen Order
games.name: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor

categories.description: Unrestricted is the fastest way to complete the game, the new route allows you to merge planets and unlock the last zone of the game through loading trigger manipulation, alongside clipping through walls and other things, a visual but totally broken run.
categories.name: Any% Unrestricted

games.description:
Fallen Order is an Action/Adventure 3D game with elements of Metroidvania in it's level design and sekiro like combats in a Star Wars setting. It's speedrun has been evolving a lot since it's release in 2019 reaching new heights with a brand new route not shown in marathon yet. It is very glitched and highly entertaining but only suffers from it's innability to skip cutscenes. (more time to explain!)
Could be part of a Bifecta with Survivor
games.name: Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order

categories.description: Standard Any% going as fast as possible beating only necessary zones (which are stages in this game) omitting 3 additional ones from All Zones category. For the race , one runner will choose Chip and other Dale to see who is the fastest Chipmunk (in practice this is just cosmetic choice) .
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Another solid Capcom Disney Game on NES based on classic cartoon. Good old standard platformer with great mechanics and graphics for its time , which makes you jump from platform to platform killing/avoiding some enemies with few refreshing gimmicks like flying on balloons and destroying bosses and the end of some stages with final one being none other than the Fat Cat.
games.name: Chip 'N Dale: Rescue Rangers

categories.description: This is standard Any% category, where every trick, skip etc is allowed in order to finish game. Commentary provided by best NES aussie runner Lucha_Gym.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: If you know DataEast company, which developed this game, then you already know this game will be special. Deity appearing from thunder, walking in just red pants and shooting from his armpits, what else do you need ? Definitely one of the best worst NES games in terms of mechanics. Manips in speedruns are standard, but how often do you have to constantly manip screen scroll, since game cannot handle diagonal scroll while walking, swimming or even flying (every god has to have wings) ?
games.name: Karnov

categories.description: This is standard Any%, where you beat every stage as fast as possible. All stages needs to be played,sinc there are no warps or stage stelect, however some nice smaller shortcuts can be implemented during run.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Konami's hidden gem on NES never showcased before on live marathon. You take the role of vampire and monster to defeat evil Warlock, who disturbed your peaceful TV watching. Standard platformer, where you go from point A to B without diverse paths, however graphics, music and feeling of being small monster inside big kitchen, construction site etc make it very enjoyable experience. Run focuses on mastering double jump mechanic and well timed hits during boss fights.
games.name: Monster in My Pocket

categories.description: Standard Any% category, where you beat all stages as fast as possible. Game has interesting mechanics of collecting bones and one bone switches for another powerup choice making runner count and collect proper number of bones to alter between bombs and barking, when necessary.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Another solid NES game developed by Atlus based on popular Hanna-Barbera cartoon under the same title. Although Wacky Races is cartoon about racing, game is platformer , where you take control of Mutley on his way to disturb all racers and make him and Dastardly win the race (what very surprisingly doesn't happen in the end).  To achive this goal, player will run through 10 diverse stages, throwing boms , barking at enemies and using tail to fly (Mutley's special mark from other cartoon).
games.name: Wacky Races

categories.description: Standard Any% category, where you beat all stages as fast as possible. In this category, mostly Plucky and Furball are utilized, where first one can fly and second can climb wall making possible to skip some sections in certain levels.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: It's old Konami, it's NES and it's Tiny Toons, so it has to be good. Great fast paced platformer, where you take control of Buster, Plucky, Dizzy or Furball to save Babs from Montana Max. In speedrun, glitched speed is introduced , where you go even faster than intended making it one of most intense NES runs in terms of speed.
games.name: Tiny Toon Adventures

categories.description: In the All Prize Bubbles category, RbdJellyfish, fritt, Krosso, and FireThieff work together to beat the story mode while collecting every prize bubble.
categories.name: All Prize Bubbles, 4P

games.description: LBP is a physics-based 2.5D platformer focused on playfulness and creativity.  Co-op runs of LBP combine a carefully crafted route, high-skill-ceiling movement tech, and a wild physics engine, which makes every run an entertaining mix of impressive coordination and chaotic improvisation.
games.name: LittleBigPlanet

categories.description: Complete the game - Reach the end of the game and give the Dragon his Sunscreen!
categories.name: Complete the Game

games.description: This is a fantastic little platform game from 1991. Colourful graphics, fun characters and amazing music! The speedrun is very execution heavy and includes a couple of short skips and some tricky platforming!
games.name: Slightly Magic

categories.description: This would be a single run of this game. Complete the game by beating all 20 levels
categories.name: Complete the Game

games.description: A classic platform game from the 1980's - this is the 2004 PC version. Miner Willy must make his fortune and escape 20 lethal caverns, populated by Manic Mining Robots, Killer Toilets and Mutant Telephones! Pixel perfect jumping and precise movement along with a very surreal aesthetic make this one something a bit different! I ran this one at ESA Winter 2023 and didn't quite finish the run - would love to have the opportunity for a salty runback :)
games.name: Manic Miner

categories.description: Complete the game by escaping and finding 30 circuit boards!
categories.name: Complete the Game

games.description: A retro style indy platformer from 2023! This is a homage to ZX Spectrum games such as Dizzy - Can Beep the robot escape from the lab? Great graphics, music and puzzle solving make this a fun platforming arcade adventure!
games.name: Beep's Escape

categories.description: Complete Level 16 - Once that level is completed the run would end. Potenially: Complete Level 24 - Once that level is completed the run would end. The extra levels between 17 and 24 are a LOT harder and showcase a lot more movement tricks and precision!
categories.name: Complete Level 16

games.description: This is my marathon submission for Chuckie Egg on the ZX Spectrum (emulated on PC). There is no end to this game, so the category I'd most likely run is Complete Level 16 (about 20 minute estimate) with a possibility of Complete Level 24 (about 40 minute estimate). This is a 1980's precision platformer with very fast action and skillful movement. I will also provide detailed commentary including a history of the game and discussion of the skills involved in running it!
games.name: Chuckie Egg

categories.description: Complete the game - Rescue all six of your friends, kill the evil wizard and find all 30 diamonds to make your own escape!
categories.name: Complete the Game

games.description: This is an arcade / adventure platform game from the 1990's on the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. Dizzy and the rest of the Yolkfolk have been cast into Magicland by the evil wizard Zaks! Not only that, all of his friends have been cursed!!! Can Dizzy free his friends, kill Zaks and somehow find his way home?? A fun colorful little romp with good music, a traditional fairytale setting and precise movement! I ran this online for ESA back in 2021 so would love the opportunity to show it off in person!
games.name: Magicland Dizzy

categories.description: A super short run that uses glitches in the games battle system to allow us to walk through the games memory with a dead party in-order to walk into the games Law ending. really short and fun run. Estimate is Generous to accomodate for RNG in finding the right encounter.
categories.name: any% (SFC)

games.description: The first game in the Shin Megami Tensei franchise, it lays the foundation for the entire franchise and all of its sibling franchises like Persona, featuring the classic first person dungeon crawling and turn-based combat that would define the entire series. Being the first game in the series it features the classic 90s Jank and offers loads of ways to play through the game with different builds or alignments for the different endings
games.name: Shin Megami Tensei

categories.description: This is the alternate storyline the player has the option of choosing at the start of the game, starting out with a quick trip to the Casino to make enough money to purchase a Megidolaon stone to make an even stronger Pixie than the Pixie used in the SEBEC route of this game.
categories.name: Snow Queen Quest Bad Ending

games.description: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona is a PSP remake of the PSX Original Revelations: Persona. this game plays a lot more like classic Shin Megami Tensei games in that the gameplay is mainly first person dungeon crawling with Turn Based Battles, This run also makes use of RNG manipulation in the beginning of the run to ensure we have the correct demons to be able to fuse into Persona's that will allow us to nuke everything in sight
games.name: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona

categories.description: The run is an any% (easy) run on the NES involving platforming as Scrooge McDuck playing through 6 unique levels; Niagara Falls, a pirate ship in the Bermuda Triangle, Mu, Egypt and Scotland.
categories.name: any% (easy)

games.description: The run is an any% run on the NES involving platforming as Scrooge McDuck playing through 6 unique levels; Niagara Falls, a pirate ship in the Bermuda Triangle, Mu, Egypt and Scotland. There are some frame perfect tricks,  menu-ing strats, an RNG dependant boss for a bit of drama and is overall a fun short & sweet speedrun.
games.name: Ducktales 2

categories.description: Go fast through walls by smashing yourself with wooden and metal boxes at illegal speeds
categories.name: Any%

games.description: 3rd person shooter with tons of skips that are possible by abusing mouse DPI and the telekinesis skill in the game
games.name: Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy

categories.description: Finish the intended storyline with NG+. Glitches allowed.
categories.name: Full Game NG+

games.description: Groot and the bois save all the galaxies. Run has some longer unskippable cutscenes, but it's still clearly mostly gameplay. Submission video is just the first half of the run, but it's a decent showcase of the commentary. Chat replay shows people clearly wanting to see the full game, certainly not because I told them to say that.
games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy

categories.description: The aforementioned Quake 2 movement is strafe jumping which makes the run really fast paced. There is basically no downtime in a run that aims to beat the game as fast as possible in this category.
categories.name: any%

games.description: What happens if you combine a voxel world like Minecraft, first person parkour movement like Mirrors Edge and sprinkle a little bit of Quake 2 movement on top? You find yourself in the world of Lemma. A 2015 first person parkour game which makes you explore a weird voxel world with some unique mechanics later introduced in the game.
games.name: Lemma

categories.description: A very goofy, not well made GBA game. There is a very simple easy glitch that allows you to go anywhere, unfortunably you can't use it anywhere.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Videogame following the story of the first season of the cartoon show Winx Club.
games.name: Winx Club

games.name: Haiku, the Robot

categories.description: We would be doing a special any% run where we share control over Keyboard and Mouse (one screen). This is significant as both character and mouse placement is important for solving the puzzles. Also Cro and I have great synergy, being at ESA together since 2016 and are decently entertaining.
categories.name: Any% (2 Players 1 M&K)

games.description: Viewfinder is a first person puzzle game with the twist in the form of polaroid photos that will manipulate the world around you. You solve the puzzles (and glitch through the game) by tactically placing photographs in specific places.
games.name: Viewfinder

categories.description: Any% Unlimited is the "regular" category that plays the game as intended - as there is another category that will lock FPS to below 30 FPS for certain glitches via CPU manipulation. In Any% we complete the game as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any% Unlimited

games.description: Traverser is an indie puzzle game from a small Swedish studio taking place in a dystopian world where large coorperations are controlling the access to clean air. The main feature of the game revolves around a gravity glove that lets you manipulate the environment and is used to solve puzzles (and sometimes glitch through them instead).
games.name: Traverser

categories.description: This run uses glitches and rng manipulations to beat Pokémon Platinum (beat Cynthia) as fast as possible. In this race we aim to showcase the route development from last few years, and the race between two runners will also use two different route that are very close in terms of time.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Pokémon Platinum Version is a 2008 role-playing video game developed by Game Freak and published by The Pokémon Company and Nintendo for the Nintendo DS handheld game console. It is the third version after Pokémon Diamond and Pearl and is part of the fourth generation of the Pokémon video game series.
games.name: Pokémon Platinum

The Inbounds category aims to fix this problem by limiting certain glitches, but allowing us to see much more of the game and showcasing many other different kinds of tricks and skips.
categories.name: Any% Inbounds

games.description: Prey is another immersive sim from Arkane Studios. Much like the previous Dishonored and Dark Messiah games, choices matter a lot and can change the outcome of the story and world. This installment takes place in space, giving the setting a more sci-fi horror vibe.
games.name: Prey (2017)

categories.description: It has death abuse. Everyone loves death abuse. The run isn't that long.  It's way shorter than the time in the video but it gives the jist. Players are tied to the same screen and you can bully the other player. It could be funny depending on Metakos mood at the time.  HOYP
categories.name: Co-Op

games.name: The Blues Brothers (SNES)

categories.description: Hard mode is basically the same route as the more popular Easy but with loads more enemies. Much higher chances to die and massive amounts of RNG. Run is more dynamic than easy as RNG will make some death warps more optimal than others.
categories.name: Any% Hard

games.description: Classic 1994 shooter set in the star wars universe. Hired by the rebellion to investigate a base that was destroyed leading to several different planets as we try and thwart a plot by the empire to create a new super weapon. Run is 14 levels where you must complete a bunch of objectives in the optimal order and pathing. Grenade jumps are very common. RNG makes no two runs alike.
games.name: Star Wars: Dark Forces

categories.description: We have found the optimal monster for speedrunning. We get it immediately and raise it's stats in power and speed to become a lightning bruiser in 31 fights (fewer if we get good RNG). DS allows Drill Skip mod to make it like the original MR2. Literally just skips the training montages.
categories.name: Any% DS Mod

games.description: One of the other monster battle RPGs that tried to ride the coat tails of Pokemon back in the 90s. The monster generation was based around putting CD's in your console which generated one of 400+ monsters available to raise. Raising is done on a ranch week by week but battling is done in real time 1v1 matches. DX was the most recent steam port based on the original Monster Farm 2 (and it's subsequent PC/Switch port. It is also the 25th anniversery of the original release!
games.name: Monster Rancher 2 DX

categories.description: Any% contains a rather annoying section that involves about 10 minutes of button mashing to get to the first forest. We will have a save file after this point. Then it's a case of getting 2 particular monsters and min maxing the battles to get them very strong very fast.
categories.name: Any% (intro skip)

games.description: The other OTHER monster battle RPG from the 90s. With art by Studio Ghibli and a very somber soundtrack this game is a fun little adventure where the Cocoon Master Levant must travel into the divine forests to search for a cure for a disease. Capturing, raising and battling using monsters you find on the way.
games.name: Jade Cocoon: Story of the Tamamayu

categories.description:
Game is basically a boss rush. Koudelka is the main damage. All cutscenes are skippable. One major RNG boss in the very late game. Hence high estimate. Good chance to go well under so have a backup in case ;) 
Video is emulator because of community convenience but I also have a physical disk copy.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A fairly obscure horror JRPG from the late 90s. Part of the Shadow Hearts series. You play as the Esper known as Koudelka. Investigating a mysterious mansion in Wales where evil spirits have been released due to a misuse of magic causing untold horrors to invade the mansion. It's a kind of survival horror where you must investigate where the evil spirits have come from and try to undo what caused this calamity.
games.name: Koudelka

categories.description: In this category we disallow only the most broken glitch in the game, anything else is fair game. And with that, we can show off all the other cool glitches and tricks that the community has found over the years. The run is a giant glitch exihibition and I would be proud to share it and it's history
categories.name: Any% Zipless

games.description:
The golden child of prince of persia games. It's clean and simple, but effective and fun. Still holds up well to this day, except for maybe the combat but we'll skip most of it anyway.
Fun platformer with lot's of puzzle elements, combat, nostalgia and character.
games.name: Prince of  Persia: The Sands of Time
